Product Marketing Manager, Autonomous Networks

Location: UK / Kuala Lumpur

Department: Communications & Marketing

About TM Forum

TM Forum is a global alliance of more than 850 communications service providers, vendors, hyperscalers and system integrators, together generating US$2 trillion in revenue and serving five billion customers across 180 countries. We unite these diverse communities to drive end-to-end change, putting the sector at the heart of the global connected economy and providing an open platform for innovation and growth.

We are seeking a hands-on Product Marketing Manager to lead marketing for TM Forum’s Autonomous Networks Mission. This role is ideal for someone who understands the realities of modern network operations and has relevant telecommunications experience gained within a communications service provider (CSP), technology or network vendor, systems integrator (SI), OSS/BSS provider or telecommunications consultancy.

You will help articulate the industry vision for autonomous operations, create compelling market narratives and drive engagement with the frameworks, benchmarks, best practices, collaborative projects and industry assets shaping the future of AI-powered network operations. Working closely with Mission leaders, member companies and technical experts, you will translate complex industry initiatives into impactful marketing programmes that accelerate adoption and demonstrate member value.

What you’ll do:

  • Work with the Director of Product Marketing and Autonomous Networks Mission leadership to develop and deliver the Mission marketing strategy and go-to-market plan.

  • Develop clear, compelling messaging and positioning that connects the industry’s network complexity, operational and commercial challenges with the value of autonomous operations.

  • Create executive-level narratives and thought leadership around Autonomous Networks, AI-powered operations, network automation, autonomous domains and the Autonomous Enterprise.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executive, commercial and technical audiences.

  • Plan and execute campaigns supporting Autonomous Networks initiatives, industry assets, benchmarks, certifications, Catalysts and member collaboration programmes.

  • Create high-quality marketing materials including industry reports, white papers, case studies, customer stories, blogs, presentations, executive briefings, webinars and website content.

  • Work closely with Mission owners, product management, technical experts, member engagement, sales, communications and events teams to align product development and collaboration activity with market needs.

  • Monitor market developments across Autonomous Networks, AIOps, intent-driven operations, service assurance, orchestration, closed-loop automation, OSS transformation and AI-native operations.

  • Conduct market, customer and competitive research to identify emerging opportunities, adoption barriers and content priorities.

  • Represent TM Forum and the Autonomous Networks Mission at DTW-Ignite, regional events, webinars and relevant industry conferences.

  • Move confidently between the big picture and hands-on delivery, producing high-quality practical outputs within short timeframes.

  • Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues, members and stakeholders at all levels across a global organisation.

  • Manage multiple priorities with strong analytical, planning and organisational discipline.

What you’ll need to succeed:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in product marketing, solution marketing, portfolio marketing, industry marketing or a closely related role within telecommunications or technology.

  • Relevant domain knowledge gained within a CSP, technology or network vendor, SI, OSS/BSS provider or telecommunications consultancy.

  • Strong understanding of network operations and operational transformation, with knowledge of areas such as OSS, service assurance, orchestration, network management, automation or service operations.

  • Experience translating complex technical propositions into differentiated, customer-focused messaging and clear business value.

  • Excellent written, verbal, presentation and storytelling skills in English.

  • Proven ability to create influential content for both executive and technical audiences.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions, organisations and geographies.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects and competing demands in a fast-paced environment.

  • A dynamic and flexible attitude, combined with the confidence to engage people at all levels.

Experience that would set you apart:

  • Direct experience of Autonomous Networks, AI-driven operations, AIOps, network automation, intent-based networking or closed-loop operations.

  • Familiarity with TM Forum’s Autonomous Networks vision, maturity levels, frameworks, benchmarks or certification programmes.

  • Knowledge of TM Forum’s Open Digital Architecture (ODA), Open APIs, cloud-native technologies and microservices architectures.

  • Experience marketing OSS, assurance, orchestration, network automation, AI, data analytics or operational transformation solutions.

What success looks like:

  • Increased awareness and understanding of TM Forum’s Autonomous Networks Mission across the global telecommunications industry.

  • Growth in member engagement with Autonomous Networks collaboration, assets, benchmarks and industry programmes.

  • A clear, differentiated and consistent Autonomous Networks narrative across campaigns, events, web content, sales enablement and thought leadership.

  • A strong pipeline of member stories, use cases and market evidence demonstrating progress towards higher levels of autonomous operation.

  • TM Forum increasingly recognised as the industry convenor and authority helping CSPs and their partners advance towards Autonomous Networks and the Autonomous Enterprise.

Why Join TM Forum?

  • Work at the centre of one of the telecommunications industry’s most significant transformation programmes, collaborating with the organisations shaping the future of AI-powered network operations.

  • Influence an entire industry ecosystem rather than marketing a single product, helping define how CSPs progress from assisted automation towards autonomous operations.

  • Build recognised thought leadership and contribute to practical frameworks, benchmarks and collaboration that accelerate industry-wide change.

  • Benefit from opportunities for professional development and advancement in a collaborative global team.

Join a supportive and inclusive work environment that values creativity, innovation and diversity. We know that sometimes the ‘perfect candidate’ doesn’t exist, and that people can be put off applying for a job if they don’t fit all the requirements. If you’re excited about working for us and have most of the skills or experience, we’re looking for, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need! We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed.

Diversity & Inclusion at TM Forum

At TM Forum, we’re building a workplace where everyone can belong, feel respected, supported and able to do their best work. We welcome talent from all walks of life to join our global community, which is made stronger by the different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences each person brings. We hire based on skills, potential and values, never on assumptions about who someone is or where they come from. We actively work to ensure our recruitment and people practices are fair, inclusive and free from bias.

jobs.description:
ION is looking for a Director of Paid Media to own paid-media strategy and performance end-to-end across HIP and Neon Canvas: Google Ads (Search, Performance Max), Meta (Facebook/Instagram), and retargeting, for a portfolio of orthodontic and dental lead-generation partners. If you've led paid media at scale, unified two brands, and want a seat where you set the standard instead of following one, we want to talk.

This is not a hands-on-keyboard media buying role.

The best fit has already run a paid-media function at a similar-size agency, managing 500-plus client accounts, and has personally unified two brands or logos under one umbrella. You won't be building campaigns in the ad accounts; your Team Leads and their specialists own that. Your job is to lead the leaders, set the strategy, own the numbers, and keep HIP and Neon Canvas ahead of every competing agency.

As Director of Paid Media, you'll lead the paid-media Team Leads, unify HIP and Neon Canvas into a single operating standard, and own client retention, delivery margin, and function growth. You'll also own innovation for the seat: scouting new ad surfaces and formats, and driving AI enablement across the paid teams, in step with the Sr. Director of Operations on company-wide AI direction.

If you're a leader of leaders who thinks in playbooks, margin, and what's next, this role was built for you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Set the paid-media strategy, playbook, and Google/Meta channel mix for HIP and Neon Canvas.
  • Own KPI attainment (ROAS, CPL, CTR by vertical), pacing, and budget governance across both brands.
  • Drive one set of standards, tooling, ad-ops processes, and QA across HIP and Neon Canvas.
  • Own escalations, QBRs, and strategy for big partners and new-logo pursuits.
  • Own the service line's P&L (revenue and margin), pricing and packaging, utilization and capacity, and growth and expansion.
  • Run pre-sales scoping and support sales as the function's expert on paid pitches and proposals.
  • Own org design, leveling and career paths, comp-band input, succession and bench planning, and the function's onboarding and L&D.
  • Manage the function's vendors, contracts, and SLAs; own its budget; own risk, compliance, and brand safety at scale.
  • Track emerging ad surfaces and formats (ChatGPT ads, Apple Maps ads, AI creative, new bidding and automation) and define how HIP and Neon Canvas adopt them ahead of competitors.
  • Lead AI enablement across the paid teams, tools, workflows, and training, leaning on the Sr. Director of Operations for company-wide direction.
  • Run 1:1s with each Team Lead for coaching, scorecard review, and unblocking; personally work the handful of at-risk or sliding partners while the leads own the rest.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You've run a paid-media function at a similar-size agency, managing 500-plus client accounts, and can hit the ground running from day one.
  • You've personally led paid media across two brands or logos operating under one umbrella, and can speak to how you unified standards, tooling, and reporting.
  • You're a leader of leaders, not just a leader of specialists; you know how to hire, level, coach, and hold other managers accountable.
  • You think in scorecards, margin, and pacing, and you can spot where a portfolio is at risk before it shows up as churn.
  • You're commercially literate; P&L, utilization, and growth aren't foreign concepts; they're how you already think about the function.
  • You're comfortable in the room with leadership, sales, and big partners, and you can deliver a QBR or handle an escalation with confidence.
  • You're genuinely energized by what's next; new ad platforms, formats, and AI tools excite you, not overwhelm you.
  • You hold your Team Leads to a high bar because you hold yourself to one.

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

  • 2+ years as a Director of Paid Media or equivalent at an agency of similar size and scope, managing 500+ client accounts.
  • Direct experience unifying paid media across two brands or logos under one umbrella.
  • 6+ years in paid media across Google Ads (Search, Performance Max) and Meta, including lead-generation for local service businesses; orthodontic or dental experience is a strong plus.
  • 2+ years leading other managers, not only individual specialists.
  • Deep platform mastery and strong analytics and experimentation skills.
  • Proven change-management ability and comfort unifying two brands or teams.
  • Commercial literacy, including delivery margin, utilization, and growth, and experience partnering with sales.
  • Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills

COMPENSATION

This role includes base pay plus variable compensation.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental Insurance
  • Health Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • PTO eligibility after 90 days of hire (10 vacation days the first year of service, unlimited PTO starting year two, flexible partial days, and sick/ personal days)

Automation Strategy Design & Implementation: Design and implement an automation strategy for the organization's IT systems using Ansible. This includes writing Ansible playbooks, setting up Ansible Tower, and integrating Ansible with other tools and platforms.

Built for both professionals and devoted pet owners, the brands products are designed with attention to detail, functionality, and longevity. The brand is committed to creating elevated, practical experiences for pets and their people—and is looking for an Inventory & Logistics Specialist to help scale that mission by ensuring seamless product flow from factory to customer.

Key Responsibilities:

Freight & Supply Chain Management

  • Manage end-to-end order placement with factories and track order progress through to completion.
  • Request, negotiate, and select the best quotes from freight forwarders, determining the optimal type of sea freight for each specific situation.
  • Design ideal loading configurations for shipping containers based on product dimensions to maximize space and reduce shipping costs.
  • Oversee the loading process through active communication with factories and freight partners.
  • Track all global shipments, proactively flagging and mitigating any potential delays.

Amazon FBA & E-commerce Operations

  • Create and manage Amazon Shipments, utilizing software solutions (e.g., 9Yards and similar simulation tools) to run multiple simulations and target the most cost-effective Amazon warehouses.
  • Oversee the receiving of units at both Amazon fulfillment centers and partner 3PL warehouses.
  • Perform thorough reconciliation for all inbound shipments to ensure accurate stock levels and file claims for missing units when necessary.
  • Coordinate Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) orders for Last Mile transport from our 3PL to customers for non-Amazon (DTC/B2B) orders.

Inventory Forecasting & Management

  • Continuously monitor inventory levels across all sales channels to prevent overstocking or Out-of-Stock (OOS) situations.
  • Forecast inventory movements and project OOS dates at the SKU level to accurately plan factory order quantities.

Reverse Logistics & Returns Management

  • Create and manage Amazon removal orders for customer returns.
  • Arrange transport from Amazon to 3PL/processing facilities.
  • Oversee the de-kitting, inspection, and sorting of damaged units into tiers for parts harvesting or resale.

Scale of Operations:

  • Container Shipments: ~8 per month.
  • LTL Orders (Last Mile): ~10 per week.
  • Factory Orders: ~6 per year.

Software & Workflow Proficiency:

  • Amazon FBA & E-commerce Systems: Deep expertise with Amazon Seller Central, FBA placement optimization, inbound reconciliation, and removal/disposal orders.
  • Forecasting & Inventory Management: Hands-on experience with IMS tools (SoStocked, RestockPro, Cin7, Skubana), advanced Excel or Google Sheets for SKU-level forecasting and run-rate models.
  • Logistics, Freight & 3PL Integration: Familiarity with container load planning software (EasyCargo, CubeMaster), freight platforms (Flexport, Freightos), warehouse management systems (ShipStation, ShipHero), and reverse logistics workflows.

Core Competencies

  • 3+ years of experience in supply chain, logistics, or Amazon inventory management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex shipments and multi-stage fulfillment workflows across international markets.
  • Strong understanding of Amazon FBA processes and multi-channel e-commerce operations.
  • Advanced analytical mindset with the ability to build and interpret detailed SKU-level forecasting and inventory models.
  • Practical experience coordinating international freight, container shipments, and 3PL operations in a multi-channel environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Alignment with the companys premium brand standards and operational excellence mindset.

Why Join Us:

  • Own inventory planning, logistics, and fulfillment workflows.
  • Work remotely from anywhere.
  • Competitive salary and flexible working hours.
  • Collaborate with a creative, forward-thinking team dedicated to innovation in the pet space.

jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) – Wealth Management is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the compliance and regulatory framework for the wealth management business. The CCO ensures adherence to applicable securities laws, fiduciary obligations, anti-money laundering regulations, privacy requirements, and industry standards while promoting a culture of integrity, ethical conduct, and regulatory excellence.

The role serves as the primary advisor to executive leadership and the Board on compliance matters and provides independent oversight of regulatory risks across wealth advisory, private banking, investment management, brokerage, trust, and fiduciary services.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide compliance strategy for the wealth management division.
  • Establish and maintain compliance policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure compliance programs align with business objectives and regulatory expectations.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on emerging regulatory developments and compliance risks.
  • Promote a strong culture of ethics, integrity, and regulatory accountability.

Regulatory Compliance Oversight

  • Ensure compliance with applicable securities, investment advisory, fiduciary, and banking regulations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Oversee regulatory examinations, inspections, and inquiries.
  • Coordinate responses to regulators and ensure timely remediation of findings.
  • Maintain effective relationships with regulatory authorities and industry bodies.

Wealth Management & Advisory Compliance

  • Oversee compliance programs covering:
    • Investment Advisory Services
    • Private Banking
    • Brokerage Services
    • Trust and Fiduciary Services
    • Retirement and Estate Planning Services
    • Discretionary Portfolio Management
  • Review new products, investment strategies, and business initiatives for regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure adherence to suitability, fiduciary, and best-interest obligations.

Financial Crime Compliance

  • Oversee Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) programs.
  • Ensure compliance with sanctions screening and anti-bribery regulations.
  • Monitor suspicious activity reporting and transaction surveillance programs.
  • Assess financial crime risks associated with clients, products, and jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate investigations and regulatory reporting requirements.

Surveillance, Monitoring & Testing

  • Establish risk-based compliance monitoring and testing programs.
  • Oversee employee trade surveillance and conflict-of-interest management.
  • Conduct periodic compliance reviews and control assessments.
  • Monitor client communications, marketing materials, and investment recommendations.
  • Ensure corrective actions are implemented for identified compliance issues.

Fiduciary & Conduct Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with fiduciary duties and client best-interest standards.
  • Oversee management of conflicts of interest and disclosure requirements.
  • Promote fair treatment of clients and ethical business practices.
  • Assess conduct risks associated with advisor and relationship manager activities.

Training & Awareness

  • Develop compliance training programs for advisors, bankers, and employees.
  • Promote awareness of regulatory obligations and ethical standards.
  • Ensure timely completion of mandatory compliance certifications.
  • Provide advisory support to business units on compliance matters.

Reporting & Board Engagement

  • Prepare compliance reports for executive leadership, risk committees, and the Board.
  • Present compliance risk assessments, monitoring results, and regulatory updates.
  • Develop key compliance indicators (KCIs) and compliance dashboards.
  • Escalate significant compliance issues and regulatory concerns.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop compliance professionals across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Build a high-performance compliance function.
  • Foster collaboration with legal, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
  • Support succession planning and talent development initiatives.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Master's degree, MBA, Juris Doctor (JD), or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)
  • Investment Adviser Certified Compliance Professional (IACCP)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Bar admission or legal qualifications may be advantageous.

Experience

  • 12–15+ years of compliance, legal, regulatory, or risk management experience.
  • Significant experience within wealth management, private banking, asset management, or brokerage environments.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise compliance programs.
  • Strong knowledge of fiduciary and investment advisory regulations.

Technical Competencies

  • Wealth Management Compliance
  • Securities Regulation
  • Investment Advisory Compliance
  • Fiduciary Oversight
  • AML/KYC Compliance
  • Financial Crime Prevention
  • Regulatory Change Management
  • Compliance Monitoring & Testing
  • Conduct Risk Management
  • Trade Surveillance
  • Conflict of Interest Management
  • Regulatory Reporting
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
  • Data Privacy & Information Security Compliance

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Ethical Judgment
  • Regulatory Influence
  • Executive Communication
  • Board Engagement
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Management
  • Team Leadership
  • Problem Solving

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Regulatory Examination Outcomes
  • Compliance Breach Frequency
  • AML/KYC Compliance Effectiveness
  • Timely Regulatory Filings
  • Compliance Monitoring Results
  • Employee Training Completion Rates
  • Remediation of Regulatory Findings
  • Fiduciary Compliance Performance
  • Internal Audit Results
  • Client Complaint and Conduct Metrics

jobs.description:
Level 1 & 2 IT Support Technician

We are seeking a Level 1 & 2 IT Support Technician to maintain the health of our hardware, software, and network infrastructure. You will serve as the first and second line of defense for technical issues — resolving what you can at first contact, digging deeper on escalated problems, and minimizing downtime through rapid incident response.

Key Responsibilities

1. Tiered Troubleshooting & Technical Support

This is the "bread and butter" of the role.

Level 1 (First Contact):

  • Serving as the first point of contact for all incoming issues via ticket, phone, chat, or walk-up.
  • Resolving common issues at first touch: password resets, account lockouts, printer problems, basic software errors, and connectivity drops.
  • Accurately logging, categorizing, and prioritizing tickets in the ticketing system (Jira, HaloPSA, or similar).

Level 2 (Escalated Support):

  • Diagnosing and resolving escalated issues: software glitches, hardware malfunctions, and "ghost in the machine" bugs that L1 couldn't close.
  • Performing root cause analysis on recurring incidents.
  • Escalating to senior engineers (L3) with clear documentation of troubleshooting steps already taken.

2. Hardware & Software Lifecycle

  • Provisioning: Setting up new laptops, workstations, and mobile devices for employees, including imaging and MDM enrollment.
  • Installation: Deploying OS updates (Windows, macOS, Linux) and enterprise software suites.
  • Maintenance: Performing hardware repairs or coordinating with vendors for warranty replacements.

3. Network & Infrastructure Support

Responsible for the "last mile" of connectivity:

  • Ensuring devices can connect to local Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and VPN.
  • Basic troubleshooting of routers, switches, and access points; escalating complex network issues to senior engineers.
  • Managing peripherals such as network printers, VOIP phones, and video conferencing equipment.

4. User Access & Security

  • Identity Management: Creating, modifying, and offboarding user accounts via Active Directory or Okta.
  • Security Compliance: Ensuring all devices have updated endpoint protection, disk encryption, and multi-factor authentication (MFA) enabled.
  • Data Recovery: Assisting users with file backups and recovering lost data.

5. Documentation & Training

A great technician doesn't just fix a problem; they make sure it's easier to fix next time.

  • Writing and updating Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and knowledge base articles for the internal IT team.
  • Creating "How-to" guides for non-technical staff to promote self-service and reduce repeat tickets.

Essential Skills & Requirements

jobs.description:
Division Controller, Schools--Ensemble Performing Arts

Remote | Accounting Leadership

Ensemble Performing Arts is seeking an experienced, systems and data savvy Division Controller for our Schools Business Unit. This role reports directly to the Corporate Controller with a heavy dotted line reporting responsibility to the Business Unit President and will own the full accounting operations for a portfolio of music and dance schools, leading system and process transformation, and enterprise/school standardization work. This role must understand the operating rhythm of a school including seasonality, tuition billing and recital/event revenue, and operate with the judgment and independence of a controller who can represent the accounting function in front of and partnering with school leadership.

This is the right fit for a controller who wants to build scalable infrastructure for a portfolio of schools, mentor other accounting leaders, and take ownership of rapidly growing business unit — while still staying close to the transaction-level detail of school operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accounting Operations & Close
    • Own accurate and timely monthly and year-end closes across a portfolio of schools, with full P&L and balance sheet accountability at each location
    • Oversee tuition and enrollment-based revenue recognition, including deferred revenue for prepaid tuition, seasonal enrollment surges, and mid-session refunds or withdrawals
    • Supervise and develop a remote accounting team, including the responsibility of an outsource relationship, across general ledger and close functions
    • Review and approve school-level financial statements and reconciliations to consolidation, acting as a first line of quality control for the Corporate Controller
    • Identify and resolve complex technical accounting issues (e.g., revenue recognition for tuition and program fees, leases for studio and school locations, purchase accounting) and document conclusions
  • Internal Controls & Compliance
    • Design, implement, and monitor internal controls across assigned schools, including cash handling, tuition billing, and refund controls, closing gaps proactively rather than reactively
    • Manage and lead audit preparation activities for the School Division, serving as the primary point of contact for external auditors
    • Partner with the Corporate Controller to standardize policies, procedures, and documentation across the Schools Division and the broader organization
    • Ensure complete capture and reconciliation of revenue processed through third-party platforms, including ticketing, events, and merchandise, so that no revenue stream is missed at month-end close
  • M&A & Systems Leadership
    • Lead onboarding of newly acquired schools into NetSuite, student billing/enrollment systems, and related systems, including opening balance sheet validation and purchase accounting support
    • Drive system migrations and process re-engineering projects — including student billing and enrollment platforms — from scoping through go-live, acting as project lead rather than participant
    • Build and maintain scalable reporting templates and chart-of-accounts standards that can be rolled out across multiple schools
    • Create and own Ensemble’s F&A integration playbook, documenting the standard onboarding process end to end [3.1]
  • Team & Cross-Functional Leadership
    • Mentor and develop accounting team members across all business units
    • Collaborate cross-functionally with FP&A, HR, and Operations to ensure accounting alignment, clean enrollment and tuition data, and consistent reporting
    • Represent the accounting function directly with School Leadership providing financial clarity on enrollment trends, tuition collections, and school-level profitability, and pushing back on issues independently
    • Act as a proactive thought partner to the Corporate Controller, surfacing risks and improvement opportunities before being asked

Who You Are

  • A builder — you don't just maintain systems, you re-architect them for scale across a growing network of schools
  • A technical resource — you can research and apply US GAAP independently, including tuition revenue recognition, and explain it clearly to non-accountants
  • A leader of leaders — you develop other accounting managers and controllers, not just individual contributors
  • A project owner — you can run a system implementation, student billing platform migration, or M&A integration from start to finish
  • A trusted operator — you can represent the accounting function in front of senior leadership and School Leaders with confidence
  • Comfortable with the seasonality of a school business — enrollment surges, session-based billing, and recital/event revenue

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance; CPA strongly preferred
  • 7+ years of progressive accounting experience, including 3+ years in a controller or senior leadership role
  • Demonstrated experience managing accounting across multi-entity, multi-state environments; experience with schools, education, membership, or subscription-based businesses is a strong plus
  • Strong US GAAP knowledge, including technical research and application to non-standard transactions
  • Solid understanding of revenue recognition, particularly as applied to tuition, program fees, and deferred revenue
  • Advanced NetSuite experience (or similar ERP), including system implementation or migration leadership; experience with student billing or enrollment management systems is a plus
  • Prior M&A integration and purchase accounting experience
  • Track record of mentoring and developing accounting staff and junior leaders
  • Comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fully remote, fast-scaling environment

Compensation & Benefits

The compensation range for this position is $125,000–$145,000 per year, commensurate with experience. A competitive benefits package is provided, including a 401(k) with employer match; health, vision, and dental benefits; and Paid Time-Off.

To Apply

Please submit the following:

  • A resume
  • A brief cover letter outlining your interest in this role
  • Responses to our short questionnaire about your background. Applications without a cover letter and questionnaire response will be considered incomplete and will not be reviewed.

Diversity is a strength of our community. If you meet most but not all of the qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

About Ensemble Performing Arts

Ensemble Performing Arts is one of the fastest-growing platforms of independently-run performing arts schools and businesses in the United States. We are powered by passionate educators and supported by a team that believes in preserving what makes each school and business unit special. With a multi-state, multi-entity footprint and active M&A pipeline, we are committed to operational excellence and a people-first culture grounded in respect, flexibility, and shared purpose. We offer opportunities for growth and leadership in a fast-scaling organization and a chance to directly shape the finance function of a mission-driven company.

Who We Are

Our mission is empowering artists by safeguarding the businesses that love them♡. Our values include:

  • Stewardship: We are caretakers of our local businesses and communities, helping them thrive by making it easy for our schools and teachers to cultivate an enriching learning experience for students.
  • Growth: Our teachers are integral to our success, and we are committed to their professional growth. As an ever-growing partnership of music and dance schools and related business units, we seek to increase the high-quality resources provided to our communities.
  • Stagehands: Our Shared Services team runs in the background to support our schools and business units. By doing this, we champion our teachers and students to be the real stars of the show!

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.

  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.

  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.

  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.

  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.

  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.

  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

The hourly earnings for this role are 23 USD per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

Qualification path

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in English.

  • Resident in Australia for the last 5 consecutive years.

  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.

  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.

  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.

  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification

  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.

  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

jobs.title: Manager, Resource & Capacity Planning
jobs.excerpt: The Manager of Resource & Capacity Planning owns the hours-and-people picture behind a portfolio of 800+ active and pipeline renewable energy projects.
jobs.description:
The Manager of Resource & Capacity Planning owns the hours-and-people picture behind a portfolio of 800+ active and pipeline renewable energy projects. Every megawatt we help design depends on having the right engineers on the right work at the right time. This role will be instrumental in architecting and implementing the firm's demand-capacity forecast in a dynamic, rapidly changing project environment.

As a trusted resource reporting directly to the Executive Vice President, you will have the responsibility of developing and maintaining resourcing plans and effectively identifying, communicating, and coordinating around scheduling and resourcing conflicts. An effective hire will be able to balance the analytical forecasting responsibilities of the role alongside the soft skills required to coordinate with multidisciplinary stakeholders, including at the executive and senior managerial level. As an employee-owner at a firm built on the mission of designing a cleaner future, your role will play a direct part in enabling projects that move the renewable energy transition forward.

Duties & Responsibilities:

Core Functional Responsibilities

  • Own the rolling demand-capacity forecast across active projects, backlog, and pipeline, refreshed on a published cadence so downstream financial and staffing decisions use current data.
  • Own and maintain the standard work breakdown structure (WBS) and planned hours across portfolios, converting probability-weighted pipeline, project schedules, and cost estimates into capacity demand.
  • Model planned-hours burn and capacity exposure by project, portfolio, discipline, and phase, delivering the hours basis used for labor cost and revenue forecasting.
  • Translate utilization, backlog, and pipeline conversion metrics into hiring indicators and staffing recommendations for leadership.
  • Provide capacity and cost-basis inputs to support proposal pricing decisions made by Client Services.
  • Coordinate with Business Development to determine how prospective projects are weighted and incorporated into the forecast model.
  • Facilitate the weekly resourcing meeting with project management and engineering managers to identify and resolve staffing conflicts in advance.
  • Serve as the intake and routing point for capacity-related requests from across the firm.
  • Escalate unresolved cross-functional resourcing conflicts through the established escalation path.
  • Maintain plan-versus-actuals variance reporting across the portfolio, flagging milestone drift and assignment gaps for correction by the owning team.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

  • Drive schedule and resourcing data quality, flagging WBS non-compliance and assignment gaps for correction by the owning team.
  • Apply the established correction protocol for timesheet and cost estimate discrepancies to maintain data accuracy.
  • Co-own metric definitions for utilization, backlog, and conversion rate with Finance and Business Development under enterprise-level governance.
  • Document the data model, metric definitions, and key assumptions so the forecast can be maintained and used by others.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Present demand-capacity forecasts to executive and senior leadership with clarity and transparency; explain underlying assumptions, respond to questions, and adjust forecasts as new information emerges.
  • Coordinate with Business Development, Finance, Client Services, and engineering leadership to maintain one shared set of pipeline, capacity, and financial data.
  • Report capacity constraints accurately and promptly, including when the findings affect proposals, schedules, or hiring plans.
  • Build alignment across functions without direct authority, raising disagreements with the responsible data owner rather than working around them.

Systems, Data & Reporting

  • Act as the accountable owner for the demand-capacity forecasting system of record and its published metrics.
  • Consolidate inputs from CRM, project management, and timekeeping platforms into a single trusted capacity view.
  • Build and maintain reporting that leadership, Finance, and Client Services can use directly, without maintaining parallel models.
  • Improve forecasting, data, and reporting workflows over time, applying automation and AI tools to reduce manual effort.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform essential duties including meeting deliverables and deadlines.
  • Perform additional related duties as assigned or directed.

Experience, Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities:

Required

  • 5–8 years in professional services operations, resource planning, or project operations, ideally in architecture, engineering, construction, or consulting.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a demand-capacity or resource forecast used by leadership to make staffing and hiring decisions.
  • Fluency in professional services economics: fixed-fee versus time-and-materials contract structures, margin math, burn rates, and backlog quality.
  • Strong analytical capability, including advanced Excel, experience building models from incomplete or inconsistent data, and the ability to interpret and validate results.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and persuasively with executives and vice presidents, including presenting unfavorable forecasts and supporting assumptions under scrutiny.
  • Ability to work at both a strategic and a detailed level, moving between WBS-level accuracy and firm-level capacity planning.
  • Demonstrated use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Copilot to support analysis, automation, or reporting workflows; coding experience is not required.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, construction management, analytics, or a similar field, or equivalent applicable work experience.
  • Ability to keep US Mountain Time Working Hours (~9 a.m. – 5 p.m., M – F.)

Preferred

  • Experience with professional services automation software (BigTime or similar), project management platforms (Teamwork, Asana, Smartsheet), or CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce).
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Experience building lightweight automations with AI assistance, such as scripts, API integrations, or data pipelines.
  • RMCP or similar resource management credential is desirable.

Benefits for Full-Time Positions:

  • Participation in Revamp's Employee Ownership ESOP program.
  • Competitive compensation with bonus.
  • Full benefits package including 99% employer-paid health, vision, life, and dental insurance.
  • Medical, dependent care, and commuter FSA.
  • Monthly health and wellness stipend.
  • Attractive vacation, sick, and holiday pay.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • 401(k) savings plan with 100% match up to 6%, vested immediately.
  • Paid volunteer time off and charitable donation matching.

About Revamp:

Founded in 2016, Revamp is the premier engineering design firm focused on large-scale renewable energy projects. We are committed to doing our part in the energy transition and providing a welcoming workplace for talented people ready to make a real difference fighting climate change. Since 2020, Revamp engineers have designed more than 10% of all solar generation capacity installed in the US.

We are made up of a diverse group of mostly remote, US-based employees spanning from the East Coast all the way to The Aloha State of Hawaii! We are artists, singers, dancers, pastry chefs, outdoor enthusiasts, animal lovers, and travelers who embrace innovation and collaboration. For more information, visit our website at .

Custom Jewelry Gem Specialist

ABOUT THE COMPANY

At CustomMade, we believe engagement rings should be as personal as the relationships they represent. We make it easy to create a ring that's both one-of-a-kind and affordable. Turns out people really like that and word is really spreading quickly! We've created 30,000 pieces of custom jewelry and helped 12,000 couples get engaged, but we're still just getting started reshaping the jewelry industry.

ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Our offering is built on a one-on-one, specialized, and custom design experience and service. As a Custom Jewelry Gem Specialist, you'll be at the heart of our gem sourcing process, responsible for selecting and procuring the right stone for each customer's project. You'll serve as the company's internal gem expert and primary decision-maker on stone selection, gem procurement, supplier management, and gem quality — supporting our customer-facing teams on all things related to gems.

This role's primary duties involve: gem sourcing and selection, purchasing and procurement, supplier (vendor) management, and quality assurance for stones. You'll be evaluated primarily on your ability to select stones that fit each customer's budget and preferences while meeting our quality standard. Because every project is custom, no two sourcing decisions are identical — you'll exercise significant discretion and independent judgment in evaluating options across our supplier network, weighing quality against cost, and making purchasing and quality decisions that directly impact customers and the business.

Essential role duties look like:

Gem sourcing & selection

  • Evaluate stones across our supplier network and select the options presented to customers, applying gem expertise and judgment on quality, value, and fit with the customer's budget and preferences.
  • Serve as the internal authority on gems — advising Project Managers and customers, and resolving gem-related questions and concerns on behalf of the company.
  • Exercise judgment in high-stakes situations — for example, a stone that fails inspection, breaks in setting, or becomes unavailable close to a customer's deadline — including deciding among substitution, re-sourcing, or customer communication strategies.

Purchasing & procurement

  • Make purchasing decisions for center stones and other gems, selecting the stone and supplier within company guidelines.
  • Manage the procurement pipeline from order through delivery and storage, coordinating with suppliers and our in-office team.
  • Identify and resolve procurement issues — delays, out-of-stock items, and reorders for stones that break in setting — and determine when project plans need to be adjusted.
  • Purchase inventory stones, deciding what to stock based on demand, pricing, and supplier availability.

Supplier management

  • Manage the company's day-to-day relationships with gem suppliers, including supplier performance, responsiveness, and quality.
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard new gem suppliers to strengthen our sourcing network.
  • Review supplier invoices for accuracy, approve them for payment, and resolve invoicing discrepancies with suppliers.

Quality assurance

  • Evaluate stones against our quality standards and determine whether they are acceptable for use in customer projects.
  • Determine the appropriate resolution for gem quality issues — accepting, returning, or replacing a stone — and negotiate remediation with suppliers.
  • Investigate and resolve customer concerns regarding stones, deciding on the appropriate remedy on behalf of the company.

Pricing & continuous improvement

  • Review and update our gem estimates and pricing to ensure they are accurate and cost-competitive, recommending changes to management.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and implement improvements to our sourcing, procurement, and quality processes; update internal gem guidance based on project experience.
  • Advise management on supplier performance, market pricing trends, and recurring gem issues.
  • Establish and maintain effective working relationships with team members, suppliers, and cross-functional partners.

This is a full-time, salaried, remote role. Though this role occasionally involves communicating with customers, it is primarily a non-customer-facing role.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

  • $60,000 – $62,000/yr
  • This is a full-time role with full benefits (health, vision, dental)
  • 401k match
  • Employee jewelry discount
  • Paid federal holidays and paid time off
  • Standard business hours, Monday–Friday schedule

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS, & ABILITIES

  • Excellent written communication skills, ability to communicate clearly
  • Excellent organization skills, and attention to detail
  • Jewelry experience
  • Resourcefulness — the ability to make good decisions in the absence of perfect information
  • Graduate Gemologist degree or previous Gemological Institute of America (GIA) course work
  • Preferred but not required
    • Project management experience
    • Experience in gem sourcing or purchasing
    • Customer experience skills
    • Bachelor's degree from a competitive college/university

Interested in this role but don't meet all the requirements listed? We'd still love to hear from you! Apply and share why you think you're right for the job and what sets you apart.

EdOps is a B-Corp which partners with schools to provide expert support in finance, accounting, and student data management, helping education leaders make informed decisions while minimizing the financial, operational, and compliance burdens of running a school. Simply put, we make it easier for school leaders to increase student achievement. Our experience working with a wide range of schools – from newly authorized charter schools to independent schools with century-long histories, and from microschools to multi-campus networks – allows us to provide high-quality finance, accounting, and student data support across diverse educational environments.

  • Quantitative or technical background in either experience or coursework as there are numbers everywhere in our work.

jobs.description:
[Bulle & Mensch] ist der deutschsprachige Video-Podcast über das echte Handwerk erfolgreicher Trader und Investoren: Setup, Psyche und der Mensch hinter den Entscheidungen.

Signale, Hypes und Lambo-Versprechen gibt es woanders. Bei uns sprechen Trading-Weltmeister, professionelle Investoren und Menschen mit außergewöhnlichen Erfolgsgeschichten offen über Strategien, Fehler, Rückschläge und das, was langfristig wirklich funktioniert.

Unser Ziel ist klar: Bis Ende 2027 wollen wir die reichweitenstärkste deutschsprachige Fin-Podcast-Marke werden – mit YouTube als Hauptplattform. Dafür wächst unser Team, und die Prozesse dahinter brauchen jemanden, der sie zusammenhält, vorantreibt und weiterdenkt.

Aufgaben

Als Projektmanager:in (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Mario und allen laufenden Prozessen rund um [Bulle & Mensch]. Du sorgst dafür, dass Redaktion, Booking, Produktion, Social Media und Partnerschaften ineinandergreifen, Deadlines eingehalten werden und nichts liegen bleibt.

Dabei bist du nicht nur Prozesshüter:in, sondern Treiber:in: Du behältst den Überblick über das Gesamtprojekt, erkennst, wo es hakt, und schiebst Themen aktiv an – auch wenn sie noch niemand explizit an dich delegiert hat. Genauso wichtig ist der zweite Teil der Rolle: Du identifizierst neue Projekte und Wachstumschancen für [Bulle & Mensch], bringst sie strukturiert auf die Schiene und begleitest sie von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.

Du arbeitest eng mit Mario und den Freelancer:innen im Team zusammen, führst Fäden zusammen, die sonst lose blieben, und sorgst mit klaren Strukturen dafür, dass gute Ideen nicht in internen Abstimmungsschleifen untergehen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Laufende Prozesse rund um Redaktion, Booking, Produktion, Social Media und Partnerschaften koordinieren und weiterentwickeln
  • Deadlines, Verantwortlichkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick behalten und proaktiv nachfassen
  • Bestehende Abläufe (u. a. in Notion) dokumentieren, vereinfachen und für das Team verständlich halten
  • Freelancer:innen und Teammitglieder koordinieren, Aufgaben verteilen und Fortschritt nachhalten
  • Engpässe, Doppelarbeit und blinde Flecken im Projekt frühzeitig erkennen und lösen
  • Neue Projektideen (Formate, Kooperationen, Kanäle, Tools) identifizieren, bewerten und strukturiert aufsetzen
  • Neue Projekte von der ersten Idee über die Planung bis zur Umsetzung begleiten und dabei die Verantwortung behalten, bis sie laufen
  • Regelmäßig mit Mario den Gesamtstatus des Projekts abstimmen und Prioritäten vorschlagen

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Medien-, Content- oder Startup-Umfeld
  • Fähigkeit, aus vielen losen Enden eine klare Struktur mit Prioritäten und Deadlines zu machen
  • Eigenständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise – du musst nicht angeschoben werden, du schiebst selbst an
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sicheres Sprachgefühl in der Kommunikation mit Team und Partnern
  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Tools wie KI Agenten oder Notion
  • Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Personen und Aufgaben zusammenzuführen
  • Offenheit für direktes Feedback sowie die Fähigkeit, Entscheidungen klar zu begründen

Benefits

Du übernimmst nicht nur Verwaltung – du hältst das Projekt zusammen und treibst sein Wachstum aktiv mit.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Du bekommst nicht nur Aufgaben zugewiesen, sondern gestaltest mit, wie das Projekt organisiert wird und wohin es sich entwickelt.
  • Klares, ambitioniertes Ziel: Reichweite ist bis Ende 2027 die zentrale Priorität. Gute Ideen verschwinden bei uns nicht hinter internen Abstimmungsschleifen.
  • Außergewöhnliches Ausgangsmaterial: Lange, ungeschönte Gespräche mit erfolgreichen Tradern, Investoren, Unternehmern und Finanzpersönlichkeiten liefern Substanz statt austauschbarer Content-Häppchen.
  • Eigene KI-Innovation: Mit Frag [Bulle & Mensch] haben wir einen eigenen KI-Podcast-Assistenten entwickelt.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Mario zusammen, bekommst schnelles, ehrliches Feedback und hast Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Gesucht ist keine einmalige Projektbetreuung, sondern eine verlässliche Zusammenarbeit mit wachsendem Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Remote und strukturiert: Klare Prozesse, Notion als zentrale Arbeitsgrundlage und möglichst wenig unnötige Meetings.

jobs.description:
Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme une référence sur le marché français.

N2F est une plateforme complète de Spend Management (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs, budget), conçue pour simplifier le quotidien des entreprises grâce à une expérience fluide, intuitive et 100 % connectée (web et mobile).

Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Pour accompagner cette croissance, nous recherchons un(e) Product Manager confirmé(e) pour rejoindre notre équipe Produit et prendre la responsabilité d’un domaine fonctionnel clé de notre plateforme. Le terrain de jeu est vaste et les défis nombreux : internationalisation, intelligence artificielle, agents, automatisation des workflows, interconnectivité, refonte fonctionnelle et amélioration continue de l’expérience utilisateur.

Tes principales missions :

Rattaché(e) à la VP Product, tu seras responsable d’un domaine fonctionnel de notre plateforme et de son évolution à long terme.

Stratégie de Produit :

  • Définir et porter la vision de ton domaine produit.

  • Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients, des utilisateurs et des équipes internes.

  • Analyser les tendances du marché, la concurrence et les évolutions technologiques afin d’identifier les meilleures opportunités de développement.

  • Participer à l’identification et à l’évaluation de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’IA, à l’automatisation et aux agents.

Gestion du Cycle de Vie du Produit :

  • Construire et piloter la roadmap de ton périmètre.

  • Identifier, qualifier et prioriser les opportunités en fonction de leur impact utilisateur et business.

  • Superviser le cycle de vie complet des fonctionnalités, de la discovery au lancement avec le Product marketing.

  • Mesurer les résultats et ajuster les orientations en fonction des retours terrain et des données.

Développement de Produit :

  • Piloter la conception et le développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités avec les équipes Product Design et Engineering.

  • Garantir une expérience utilisateur simple, intuitive et performante.

  • Valider les solutions proposées grâce à des tests utilisateurs, des analyses de données et des expérimentations.

  • Veiller à délivrer des solutions pragmatiques, robustes et créatrices de valeur.

Le travail collaboratif est au cœur du rôle :

  • Travailler étroitement avec les équipes Sales, Customer Success et Support afin de comprendre les enjeux clients.

  • Communiquer régulièrement avec les parties prenantes internes et externes.

  • Favoriser l’alignement autour des priorités produit.

  • Participer à la promotion du produit en interne et en externe.

  • Contribuer à la diffusion de la culture Produit au sein de l’entreprise.

Requirements

Ce que l’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu disposes d’au moins 4 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement dans un environnement SaaS B2B.

  • Tu sais appréhender des problématiques métier complexes et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.

  • Tu maîtrises les méthodologies agiles et les bonnes pratiques Produit.

  • Tu es capable de piloter un sujet en autonomie et d’embarquer les équipes autour de tes projets.

  • Tu sais arbitrer, prioriser et faire des choix pragmatiques et orientés impact.

  • Tu as déjà mené des projets d’envergure impliquant plusieurs parties prenantes.

  • Tu possèdes d’excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration.

  • Tu es curieux(se), rigoureux(se) et tu cherches à comprendre les sujets en profondeur avant de prendre des décisions.

  • Tu disposes d’un esprit analytique fort tout en gardant une forte orientation utilisateur.

  • Une sensibilité forte à l’IA est attendue

    • Tu t’intéresses activement aux évolutions de l’intelligence artificielle et à leurs applications concrètes dans les produits SaaS.

    • Tu utilises régulièrement des outils tels que ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini ou des assistants IA similaires dans ton quotidien professionnel.

    • Tu sais identifier les opportunités où l’IA, les LLM, l’OCR ou les agents peuvent apporter une valeur tangible aux utilisateurs.

    • Tu sais distinguer les effets de mode des usages réellement créateurs de valeur.

  • Tu es bilingue Français / anglais.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise rentable, en forte croissance et ambitieuse à l’échelle européenne.

  • Travailler sur un produit utilisé par plus d’un million d’utilisateurs à travers le monde.

  • Évoluer dans une équipe Produit structurée composée de Product Managers, Product Designers et Product Marketing Manager.

  • Contribuer à des sujets stratégiques mêlant SaaS, finance, IA et automatisation.

  • Bénéficier d’un environnement collaboratif où les idées sont écoutées et où l’impact individuel est réel.

  • Avoir la possibilité de délivrer rapidement de la valeur et de voir concrètement les résultats de son travail.

Poste ouvert en CDI et full remote.

jobs.description:
QA Engineer, Web and Mobile

Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.

Salary: €5000 per month

Location: Poland (Fully Remote)

The role

You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.

Underneath it, the point of this role is to understand how the product actually works: the data flow, the API contracts, the places where two systems meet and produce behaviour nobody specified. That understanding is what lets you improve a specification before code is written, catch the gap nobody else noticed, and give Support, Sales, Product and Engineering an answer they can rely on.

We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.

What you will do

Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.

Own our automated coverage on web. Extend and maintain the Playwright suite and write new tests for the features you take through. Investigate failures and fix flakiness rather than muting it, and be honest about what automation is and is not covering.

Verify at the API and data layer. Requests, responses, payloads, status codes, backward compatibility for older clients. Query the database directly to confirm what actually happened, rather than what the screen says happened.

Prevent bugs, not just report them. Pressure-test specifications with Product, Design and engineers before development starts: happy paths, edge cases, error states, empty states. Point out the platform that was forgotten, the API version that will break, the migration nobody planned. Asking the awkward question early is part of the job.

Debug to root cause. "It doesn't work" is not a bug report. Narrow down where it breaks and what the system is actually doing, and hand the developer something they can act on.

Support the wider business. Reproduce and triage customer issues that reach engineering, and keep test plans and known-issue lists current so release decisions rest on evidence.

Use AI every day. Reduce your own repetitive work with it, build reusable AI skills the wider team can benefit from, make small fixes in the code yourself where that is reasonable, and bring ideas about where AI can raise our quality bar.

What we are looking for

  • Three to five years of hands-on testing of web applications, with a demonstrated ability to find root causes rather than symptoms.

  • Practical test automation experience. You have written and maintained UI or API tests in Playwright, or a comparable framework, and can work in a test codebase without hand-holding.

  • You can read and reason about API contracts and payloads, query a database in SQL to verify data, and are comfortable with traffic and API inspection tooling, or quick to pick it up.

  • Mobile testing in practice. You can tell a platform convention apart from a defect, and reason about the device and OS coverage a given change actually needs.

  • Proven collaboration with Design and Product. You have been in the room during specification work and made it better without owning it, with examples you can talk us through.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication, in Polish and English, both at C2 or native level.

Nice to have

  • Testing in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent domain.

  • Device farms or cloud device labs, such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

  • Triaging from crash and error monitoring, such as Sentry or Crashlytics.

  • Accessibility testing (WCAG).
