ABOUT CATF

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a nonprofit organisation working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalysing the rapid global development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. This is accomplished through research and analysis, public advocacy leadership, and partnership with the private sector. CATF is highly respected for its deep expertise and research on energy and industrial systems and potential strategies, technologies, and policies that can radically shrink their impact on the planet’s atmosphere. Our team of experts and advocates (and global network of subject matter experts and civil society partners) put this research and knowledge into action by designing and enacting public policies that drive toward zero emissions. We also support policies and work directly with private industry to innovate in technology to make the path to zero emissions swift and affordable. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington D.C., and Brussels, with staff working virtually around the world.

ROLE

CATF is seeking an experienced and dynamic U.S. Director to join our Nuclear Energy Program. Reporting to the Program Director and managing a U.S. based senior policy manager, this individual will serve as an in-house subject matter expert in nuclear energy policy, with a focus on U.S federal and state advocacy, commercial nuclear energy industry, federal and state policy to support nuclear energy scaling, market dynamics, and regulatory ecosystems. The U.S. Director will support CATF’s nuclear energy strategy through policy advocacy, stakeholder engagement, project implementation, and outreach efforts, with an emphasis on advancing nuclear energy deployment in the U.S.

Key Functions and Responsibilities:

Nuclear policy and regulatory expertise

  • Serve as the in-house expert on nuclear policy, advocacy and related topics, particularly focused on the U.S. state and federal policy and regulatory ecosystems.
  • Identify, synthesize, and communicate key technical and economic trends across the U.S. nuclear energy sector, including industry players, government organizations, and regional markets.
  • Lead and manage policy research on nuclear energy technologies, delivering informed analysis regarding their contribution to U.S. climate and energy objectives.
  • Collaborate with CATF’s global nuclear fission energy team and multiple external stakeholders, engage in knowledge sharing and best practices.

Stakeholder engagement and outreach

  • Collaborate closely with the U.S. Advocacy team (federal, state, policy impact, and legal) on policy and advocacy activities related to nuclear energy, ensuring that CATF’s federal and state policy priorities are reflected in implementation strategies and campaigns.
  • Proactively engage external stakeholders, including federal and state policymakers, industry leaders, and NGOs, to drive policy and advocacy activities aligned with CATF’s nuclear energy strategy, projects, and initiatives in liaison with the U.S. Advocacy Team.
  • Lead outreach efforts to promote advanced nuclear technologies, coordinating efforts with U.S. government organizations, industry groups, non-governmental organizations and academic institutions in coordination with the Director for Nuclear Energy.
  • Serve as spokesperson on U.S. nuclear energy policy matters, representing CATF at high-level meetings, conferences, and public forums.
  • Engage with state-level policy and regulatory bodies to support regional nuclear energy deployment initiatives.

Project management and implementation

  • Develop and execute detailed work plans to ensure the successful implementation of U.S. nuclear energy strategy within CATF’s broader strategy
  • Lead hands-on execution of outreach, policy initiatives, and project implementation efforts that promote advanced nuclear technologies as part of the U.S. energy transition.
  • Oversee and produce relevant analyses and materials such as blogs, op-eds, factsheets and short white papers.
  • Oversee policy and analytical consultants as necessary.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with CATF teams to ensure U.S. nuclear energy initiatives are aligned with the organization’s goals and contribute to decarbonization efforts.

Commercial awareness

  • Maintain commercial awareness of U.S. nuclear energy market developments and ensure CATF’s activities are aligned with the evolving needs of the U.S. nuclear energy industry.

Leadership and collaboration

  • Provide strategic leadership in advancing nuclear energy initiatives in the U.S., reporting to and working closely with the U.S. Senior Manager and Director of Nuclear Energy.
  • Lead the U.S. nuclear energy program team, including managerial oversight of one employee.
  • Closely collaborate across the nuclear energy program team, in particular with the U.S. Senior Manager and Director of Nuclear Energy, as well as external partner organizations.
  • Cross-collaborate effectively in a matrix organization such as with communications, other programs, and cross-functional teams.
  • Engage in regular travel within the U.S. and periodic international travel to meet with stakeholders, attend industry events, and advocate for nuclear energy solutions.
  • Coach and collaborate with junior staff, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative work environment across CATF teams.
  • Ensure that U.S.-focused program activities are cost-effective and aligned with CATF’s budget.

Skills/Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of congressional and legislative processes and procedures.
  • Senior experience in the U.S. energy sector, with a strong focus on policy development and implementation, advocacy, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Extensive knowledge of energy industry, and policy and regulatory ecosystems, along with an established network in the sector.
  • Technical expertise is a plus but not required.
  • Ability to identify and communicate complex policy and regulatory trends across the U.S. nuclear energy sector.
  • Experience in driving federal and state policy and advocacy initiatives, engaging with government organizations and other stakeholders at the highest levels.
  • Experience leading a team, including management of resources, prioritizing employee growth development, and leading a team to deliver effective results.
  • Experience working across teams to ensure coordinated efforts on policy implementation.
  • Can do, positive and hands-on attitude in line with CATF core values of persistence, collaboration, and curiosity.

•International experience a plus.

  • Advanced degree (e.g., Master's, J.D. or Ph.D.) in energy policy, political science, government affairs, communications, or a related field.

jobs.excerpt: About VeedmaVeedma is a telehealth practice for men's hormonal and sexual health.
jobs.description:
About Veedma

Veedma is a telehealth practice for men's hormonal and sexual health. We treat low testosterone, erectile dysfunction, and the symptoms men actually feel: libido, erection, energy, strength, and mood, in men 18 and up, fully online. Most low testosterone is secondary and reversible, so we find the cause first and stimulate the body's own production before resorting to TRT. Enclomiphene is the foundation; Tadalafil is co-prescribed when erectile or prostate symptoms coexist with low Free Testosterone. Testosterone replacement therapy is not a service we currently offer.

Small team, founder-led, AI-native by default. Both founders code in Claude Code every day, and internal tools get rewritten faster than they get maintained.

About the founders

You will work with both of us directly, every day.

Vladimir Kotlov, MD - Founder & CEO. Urologist by training (MD, 2014) with clinical experience in men's reproductive health. The clinical voice in every product call. ()

Victor Kuznetsov - Founder & CTO. 20+ years in software engineering and AI/ML. Previously Co-Founder & CTO of Yva.ai (people analytics, acquired by Visier). Owns the Veedma platform end-to-end today. ()

If the people you would be reporting to matters to you (it should), open both profiles before you apply.

What this role is not

Not SEO. Not paid acquisition. Not "manage the agency". Not "optimize the existing funnel by 3%". We don't have a media budget and we don't plan to start one. If you measure your seniority by the size of the paid budget you have managed, wrong seat.

What this role is

A builder who happens to do growth. Some bets are quick - a referral tweak, a landing page test, a podcast pitch that lands a guest spot, a creator DM that starts a real conversation. Others compound - a content engine, a community presence, a referral mechanism that gets sharper every month. You run several at once on different time horizons, and you build the tooling that makes that possible. Claude Code is your default surface; scrapers, agents, and scrappy internal tools are how the work gets done. Every channel is a system to reverse-engineer. Leverage comes from content the audience wants to share, creators who would talk about us without being paid to, communities we are part of, referral loops, and the patient experience itself.

You probably fit if

When you see a broken funnel, a slow page, a creator who would convert - your hand is already moving toward the keyboard. You don't wait for permission, a brief, a meeting, a vendor. You ship something rough today and learn from it tomorrow. You're personally interested in men's health, hormone optimization, sexual health, or longevity - the best growth people we've seen in this space were users of the category before they marketed it. You don't need to be a Veedma patient, but you should be the kind of person who would consider becoming one.

What you will own

  • How many tests are live this week. That, and patients added this quarter. Not dashboards.

  • New channels. Find ones nobody at Veedma is running - communities we should be in, podcasts where we should be guests, creators whose audience overlaps with ours, referral loops, adjacent practices. Prove or kill in 2-4 weeks.

  • Creator and community relationships. Find the voices in men's health, performance, and longevity who matter. Build relationships with them as a peer, not a buyer - we don't pay for posts. Turn it into a system, not a one-off ask.

  • Referrals and loops. Build the way existing patients bring new ones in. Instrument it. Make it sharper every month.

  • Landing pages and funnel tests. Write the copy, wire up the test, read the data.

  • Agents do the boring parts. By month 12, your routine work runs as agents you wrote. The day clears for figuring out what to build next.

What we are looking for

  • 10+ years in growth, organic acquisition, partnerships, or "founding growth" roles. Senior, hands-on. You have taken at least one brand from early traction to scale without leaning on paid media.

  • Healthcare is in your background. Most of those years were spent on a healthcare, telehealth, pharmacy, or supplements brand. Not "wellness-adjacent" SaaS. Not a fitness app. Real healthcare.

  • You want to stay in healthcare. You are not looking at us as a stop between two consumer-tech roles. When you describe your next 5 years, the words "health", "medicine", or "patients" show up unprompted.

  • Claude Code is your primary tool. Not "I have tried it", not "I use ChatGPT sometimes". 6+ months of daily use, 4+ hours per day. You write skills, wire up MCP integrations, compose sub-agents, automate the boring parts yourself. If you cannot describe your Claude Code workflow in concrete detail, wrong seat.

  • You build, you don't wait. Scrapers, prompt pipelines, no-code automations, ugly internal dashboards, scrappy landing pages - you ship them yourself. If engineering is the bottleneck, you have already routed around it.

  • When the data isn't there, you write the query. Cohort tables, funnel reports, ad-hoc digs in the warehouse - you do not file a ticket. Basic SQL.

  • Rules for marketing prescription telehealth in the US (FTC truth-in-advertising, no medical claims, HIPAA-adjacent) - known cold. You have shipped compliant content and creator briefs.

  • Copy is yours. No agency between you and the channel.

Nice to have

  • Worked at Hims, Ro, Hone, Maximus, or a similar DTC telehealth.

  • Hormone health, men's health, or sexual health specifically.

  • A repo, a Loom, or a writeup of an automation or growth hack you built and shipped.

How we operate

  • AI-native, not AI-curious. Both founders code in Claude Code every day. New hires do the same on day one. The bar for "should this be a tool" is hours, not weeks.

  • No queues, no tickets pointed at yourself. If you see it broken, you fix it. If a creator outreach script would save you four hours a week, you build it Friday. We don't wait.

  • Never idle. Always something being tested, a signal we're chasing, a part of the product getting tighter. A week without a new experiment is a broken week.

  • Signals over opinions. What patients message us, what support tickets say, where the funnel breaks, what creators reply, what the data shows - that sets the agenda. The product changes when the data says so, fast.

  • Straight line to the founders. No layers. You're in the room (Slack, Linear, the weekly call) where product, clinical, and business decisions happen. You're expected to weigh in.

  • Business-engaged or wrong seat. Not someone who clocks in, ships a brief, and goes home. Someone who reads the retention numbers, has a view on the pricing page, and pings us at 9pm when the data is off.

  • Async-first, US hours overlap. We ship every day at minimum.

    Compensation: $150,000-$190,000 per year plus 1.0%-1.25% equity. This role is remote in the United States and does not offer visa sponsorship.

jobs.description:
iMerit is looking for detail oriented analysts to evaluate and rank AI generated responses to image based prompts. You will judge answers on accuracy, relevance, clarity, conciseness, safety, localization, and how well they follow the user's instructions, then explain your reasoning in writing.
Much of the job comes down to this: look at the image, look at what the model said about it, and decide whether the two actually match.

What you will do

  • Interpret conversational context and identify what the user really wanted

  • Rate and rank responses against defined quality criteria

  • Compare multiple answers and explain in writing why one wins

  • Verify factual claims using approved research sources

  • Flag tasks that cannot be reliably assessed rather than guessing

What you bring:

  • Strong critical thinking and sound judgment in ambiguous cases

  • Solid research skills and attention to detail

  • Excellent reading comprehension

  • Self direction and the discipline to hit deadlines without supervision

Good to know

  • Independent contractor engagement for the length of the project. 

  • Fully remote and flexible.

Job Title: Cybersecurity Analyst - Master-Level Internship

Level: Master’s Level Internship

Department: IT and Security

Duration: 520 Hours (approximately 3 months)

Work location: Remote (with hybrid options in Toronto)

Compensation: Hourly ($32)

About Us: At Vosyn, we embrace the exciting, game-changing world of Artificial Intelligence, driving innovation and pioneering impactful projects across various industries. We are a trailblazing Language Synthesis AI firm reshaping global communication by dissolving language barriers and empowering users. We believe in fostering a culture of flexibility, continuous improvement, and solution-focused strategies. Here, every idea is welcomed, nurtured, and has the potential to scale to new heights. Currently, we're at the forefront of a significant IPO endeavor, truly a unicorn in the making. We invite you to be part of our journey and leave your imprint on the future of AI.

About the Role: As a Cybersecurity Analyst, you will play a critical role in safeguarding the organization’s IT infrastructure, sensitive data, and digital assets against cyber threats. This position requires a proactive professional who can monitor security systems, identify vulnerabilities, and respond to incidents while ensuring compliance with Canadian regulatory standards and global security frameworks.

You will collaborate with IT teams to strengthen cybersecurity practices, develop secure protocols, and protect the organization against emerging threats. This immersive internship offers hands-on experience, collaboration with senior management, and the opportunity to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. While demanding, it promises to be a rewarding complement to your academic journey, equipping you with valuable skills and insights.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor and analyze security systems, networks, and applications to detect and mitigate threats.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration tests to identify and resolve security weaknesses.
  • Investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents, including analyzing root causes and implementing solutions.
  • Implement and manage security tools such as firewalls, intrusion detection systems, and endpoint protection.
  • Develop and maintain security policies, procedures, and documentation.
  • Provide guidance and training to employees on cybersecurity best practices.
  • Stay updated on the latest security threats, trends, and technologies to strengthen defenses.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

About You:

  • Currently enrolled or recently graduated from a Master’s program in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Master’s program enrollment or completion is mandatory.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, risk management, and threat analysis.
  • Experience with cybersecurity tools, such as SIEM platforms, firewalls, and vulnerability management tools.
  • Familiarity with regulatory requirements and cybersecurity frameworks applicable to Canada.
  • Knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST, or CIS Controls is a strong asset.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex security challenges.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical teams.
  • Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, or other relevant credentials are a plus.
  • Ability to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • New graduates are encouraged to apply

We believe exceptional talent often emerges from diverse paths. If you possess a profound curiosity, a genuine passion for continuous personal and professional growth, and a strong desire to apply your unique abilities to create significant impact within our team, we strongly encourage you to apply—even if your background doesn’t align perfectly with every single qualification.

Why Join Us:

  • Be part of the invigorating journey of a start-up transitioning to an IPO.
  • Engage directly with senior management and strategic advisory board members.
  • Enhance your CV with a rich array of experiences unique to Vosyn and AI Venture Lab.
  • Gain hands-on experience contributing to projects that drive growth and make a lasting impact in a fast-paced startup environment.

DEI and Workplace Safety:

At Vosyn Inc., we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every employee feels valued and supported. We believe that diversity of thought, background, and experience enriches our company culture and enhances innovation. We are an equal-opportunity employer and encourage candidates from all walks of life to apply. As part of our commitment to creating a safe and healthy work environment, we prioritize workplace safety, adhering to all relevant regulations and promoting a culture of responsibility. We believe that a safe and inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our team members. Join us in building a workplace that values diversity, prioritizes equity, and ensures the safety and well-being of every individual.

Recruitment Process:

  1. Application Submission: Candidates are invited to submit their resumes and cover letters through our career portal.
  2. Written Questionnaire: Selected candidates will receive a set of 10 written questions to assess their fit and technical knowledge..
  3. Video Questionnaire: Candidates who successfully pass the written assessment will be asked to answer 10 additional questions to be submitted in a video format to further evaluate their skills and cultural fit. The ability to video record your answers will be required.
  4. Evaluation: Our team will review the responses to both questionnaires. Candidates who meet our criteria will be invited to the next stage.
  5. Orientation Session: Successful candidates will be invited to participate in an orientation session where they will learn more about Vosyn, our projects, and what to expect during the internship. jobs.description:
Who We Are

Liberum exists to deliver in the environments where most firms struggle. Our clients are public sector agencies navigating enterprise-scale transformations in politically complex, high-stakes environments where the margin for error is thin, and the consequences of failure are public. We believe clients deserve real ownership, not warm bodies and hope.

We’re a team first. We are not a loose collection of consultants sharing a logo, but a genuine team that pushes each other’s thinking, pressure-tests each other’s work, and shows up when engagements get hard. The people we hire make the entire team better, not just their own deliverables.

We’re also building an AI-forward consulting practice. Our project managers don’t manage projects the way they did five years ago. They use AI to see around corners, move faster, and deliver sharper analysis than consultants who are still doing everything manually. If your toolkit hasn’t evolved to include AI as a core capability, you’re already behind the standard at Liberum.

If you’re looking for a comfortable seat and a steady paycheck, this isn’t the role. If you want to be part of a team that does hard things extraordinarily well, staying on the leading edge of how that work gets done, keep reading.

The Role

This is a senior project management position for someone who doesn’t just manage projects. They own them. You will serve as the driving force behind complex, multi-workstream engagements for Washington State agencies, and you’ll be expected to flex beyond traditional PM boundaries when the engagement demands it. The right candidate isn’t precious about their role definition; they do what needs doing to ensure delivery.

You bring deep public sector experience, ERP implementation knowledge, and a technical background that lets you go toe-to-toe with system integrators and technical teams, not just manage the schedule while others make the real decisions. Your planning rigor is genuine: resource-loaded schedules, dependency mapping, and the discipline to keep plans current and actionable. You know the difference between a project plan that drives execution and one that exists to satisfy a governance checkbox.

You are an AI-enabled project manager. You use AI tools to analyze project data and surface risks before they escalate. You generate executive-ready status reports and briefings in a fraction of the time it takes traditional PMs. You use AI to synthesize complex information from multiple workstreams into clear decision frameworks. You automate the repetitive reporting and documentation work that consumes most PMs’ time, freeing yourself to focus on the strategic and political work that actually determines whether a project succeeds or fails. AI isn’t a nice-to-have in your toolkit. It’s how you operate at a level that would otherwise be impossible.

You operate with an ownership mentality. You drive work forward, take responsibility for outcomes beyond your immediate scope, and build clarity when things are ambiguous or off-track, without waiting for direction. You’re comfortable delivering hard truths to executive stakeholders with data and a solution already in hand. When a project starts going sideways, you’re the person who names it, frames it, and leads the recovery, not the person who waits for someone else to notice.

As a Liberum team member, you collaborate fully, communicate proactively, and never operate in isolation. You see the big picture while owning your piece of it. You make the people and engagements around you better.

What You’ll Do

Project Delivery & Governance

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex, multi-workstream engagements including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and issue management
  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed MS Project plans with dependencies, resource loading, and elaborated tasks; apply hybrid Agile/Waterfall approaches appropriate to the engagement context
  • Drive clarity and alignment when project conditions are ambiguous, off-track, or politically complex, including developing recovery plans and realignment strategies
  • Facilitate project status reporting, executive briefings, and governance checkpoints
  • Deliver status updates and executive reporting in visually compelling formats that tell the right story for the right audience
  • Identify and proactively manage project risks and dependencies across interconnected workstreams before they become fire drills

AI-Enabled Project Leadership

  • Use AI tools to analyze project data across workstreams, identifying schedule risks, resource conflicts, dependency chains, and early-warning patterns that inform proactive decision-making
  • Use AI to rapidly produce executive-ready deliverables: status reports, risk assessments, decision briefs, and governance presentations at a quality and speed that traditional approaches can’t match
  • Apply AI to synthesize information from multiple sources: meeting notes, vendor updates, technical documentation, stakeholder feedback, into clear, consolidated views that drive alignment
  • Use AI to automate repetitive PM work: status aggregation, action item tracking, schedule variance analysis, and reporting workflows, freeing capacity for the strategic and political work that determines project outcomes
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools that improve project delivery, and share innovations with the Liberum team to raise the collective capability

Technical Engagement & Integration

  • Support configuration, testing, and validation activities including UAT planning and execution. You understand the technical work well enough to spot problems, not just track timelines
  • Coordinate across vendor, state agency, and internal Liberum team members to ensure integrated delivery across all workstreams
  • Engage with system integrators and technical teams as a credible counterpart who understands the substance of what’s being built, not just the project mechanics

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Manage relationships with executive sponsors, steering committees, and cross-functional stakeholders across state agency environments
  • Engage and build foundational relationships with customers, project sponsors, vendors, and external stakeholders
  • Proactively communicate project progress, risks, and value delivered to client stakeholders, ensuring visibility into team contributions throughout the engagement

Team & Client Development

  • Coach and mentor client-side staff to build internal PM capability that outlasts the engagement
  • Collaborate with OCM, training, and communications teams to ensure project management outputs support adoption and readiness activities
  • Identify opportunities to create additional client value throughout the engagement lifecycle

Requirements

What We Require

These aren’t suggestions. If you can’t back each of these up with specific examples, this isn’t the right fit yet.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 8+ years of project management experience with demonstrated senior-level performance, not just years of service, but increasing scope, complexity, and accountability you can walk us through
  • Direct experience supporting or delivering at least one major ERP implementation (Workday, SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, or equivalent)
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects in highly regulated or politically sensitive environments, where decisions happen in hallways and governance structures don’t tell the full story
  • Experience facilitating executive-level stakeholder engagement, including steering committees and sponsor briefings
  • Experience conducting business interviews and leading client workshops at both operational and leadership levels
  • Active, daily use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) integrated into your project management workflow, not occasional experimentation, but a core part of how you deliver. You should be able to walk us through specific examples of how AI has improved your project outcomes, delivery speed, or analytical depth.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI for project analysis, risk identification, status synthesis, deliverable creation, and reporting in a professional consulting context
  • Comfort prompting and directing AI tools effectively. You understand how to get high-quality, contextually appropriate outputs and you know when AI output needs human judgment applied
  • Intellectual curiosity and initiative around emerging AI capabilities. Proactively experiment with new tools and bring innovations to your team rather than waiting for someone else to figure it out
  • Strong writing skills: the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise deliverables for both technical audiences and executive stakeholders
  • Hybrid methodology fluency: ability to blend Agile and Waterfall approaches pragmatically based on what the project and client actually need
  • Proficiency in MS Project or equivalent scheduling tools, including dependency mapping and resource-loaded plans
  • Professional courage to deliver difficult findings and recommendations with data, grace, and actionable solutions
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively within a remote or hybrid team environment
  • Exceptional client relationship management skills

What Sets You Apart

Not required, but these will move you to the front of the line.

  • Prosci or equivalent OCM certification
  • PMI-PBA or CBAP certification
  • Track record of rescuing or recovering troubled projects, not just running healthy ones
  • Experience building custom AI workflows, prompt libraries, or automated project management pipelines that measurably improved delivery efficiency or quality
  • Familiarity with AI-powered project analytics, predictive scheduling, or automated reporting tools
  • History of introducing AI tools or practices to a team or client organization and successfully driving adoption

Benefits

Why Liberum

  • You’ll work alongside people who are as good at this as you are, a team where excellence is the baseline, not the exception
  • The work is real: complex, politically nuanced, enterprise-scale transformations that actually matter to the State of Washington
  • We’re building an AI-forward practice. You’ll be part of a team that’s redefining how project management consulting is done, not just doing it faster with the same old tools

  • Lead our LLM strategy, including fine-tuning open-weight foundation models, designing evaluation harnesses, and making principled build-vs-buy decisions between self-hosted and frontier API models across accuracy, cost, latency, and privacy constraints
  • Bring a research-oriented mindset to production problems: read and translate current literature into practice, design rigorous experiments and ablations, and know when a published technique will or won't transfer to our data distribution
  • Design the data flywheel, including labeling pipelines, human-in-the-loop feedback, and drift monitoring, so our models improve continuously from production signals
  • Set engineering standards for model evaluation, calibration, reproducibility, and responsible deployment; be the person others seek out for design reviews on anything ML-shaped
  • Mentor and multiply: grow senior and mid-level ML engineers through code review, pairing, and technical guidance; influence roadmaps in partnership with product and platform leadership

  • Production experience in at least one of: recommendation systems, personalization, or search/ranking; you have built systems that learn from user behavior at scale, handled feedback loops and position bias, and shipped models where offline metrics had to survive contact with online reality
  • Strong data reasoning fundamentals: sampling and class imbalance, evaluation design and metric selection, confidence calibration, leakage detection, distribution shift, and the statistical judgment to know when an A/B result or benchmark number is real versus noise
  • Research-oriented mindset with shipping discipline: you follow the literature, form hypotheses, and run disciplined experiments, but you measure success by what reaches production and moves business metrics

jobs.excerpt: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
jobs.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

You'll be in front of partners and customers, owning the material that moves deals, and driving joint opportunities through the pipeline to close. You'll flex between managing partners and project-managing the joint initiatives, integrations, and go-to-market motions that run across them—keeping work moving, stakeholders aligned, and timelines honest. This role will report directly to our Senior Director of Partnerships, Margo McCabe.

This role will include a ramp up period, and you'll likely eventually own one or two strategic partners deeply rather than spreading thin across the full ecosystem—though scope flexes as company priorities shift. We move fast, wear many hats, and value people who flex to get things done.

  • Bring customer and partner feedback to our internal product teams

Harper operates as an all-hands-on-deck organization when necessary and you'll have significant support—but you'll also have significant autonomy.   • Oversee the success of your team’s projects, driving resiliency, scalability, and coverage across dynamic DOM structures, varying mobile/desktop portal designs, and application suspension states.
  • Introduce industry-leading engineering patterns and practices that give the team confidence to operate at scale.
  • Make consistent development contributions so as to maintain competency with the codebase and system architecture.

  • 10+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, deeply focused on advanced web automation, browser internals, extension development, or complex frontend-to-backend data extraction.

  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent years of work experience.
  • Proven track record of managing teams that have delivered complex, production-grade browser automation, extension, or data infrastructure products.
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript and JavaScript, specifically regarding DOM manipulation, modern web APIs, and strict browser execution environments.
  • Strong backend experience, ideally with Golang (or Node.js/Python), to guide the design of operational infrastructure.
  • Strong security fundamentals: deep understanding of secure message passing across trust boundaries (JS bridges, isolated vs. main worlds), secure authentication handshakes, and mitigating DOM-based injection risks.

About zerohash

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

Closer — HighKey Enterprises

HighKey is a premium agency specializing in social media management, press, and paid patient acquisition for cash-pay medical aesthetics and wellness clinics doing $250K+ per month.

We work with plastic surgeons, med spas, longevity clinics, and high-end practitioners who want to dominate their market.

The leads are inbound and paid for. We need someone who can close them.

What You're Selling

Two streams. You work both.

Stream A is HighKey's agency retainer (SMM, press, ads).

Average client is $6,500/month on a 52-week contract. Commission is retention-based. You earn 10% of each client's monthly payment for months 1 to 3, 7.5% for months 4 to 6, and 5% for months 7 to 12.

Every client you close pays you every month they stay active, for up to 12 months. Each new close stacks on top of your existing retained clients.

Your Stream A income grows every month without needing to increase volume. That is the compounding mechanic that separates this role from a standard closer position.

Stream B is patient acquisition for partner clinics. HighKey runs the ads, and you close patients on procedure packages averaging $20,000.

You collect a deposit and book the consult. No medical advice. Flat commission of approximately $1,000 per close.

If you source a deal yourself through cold outreach or your personal network, you earn a 5% bonus on the month 1 payment on top of standard rates. Proof of origin required.

What the Numbers Look Like

Month 1 is a paid ramp. You spend it learning the product, the script, and the pipeline as an SDR at $25/hr before taking closer calls. This is intentional. Closers who skip the ramp underperform.

Month 2 to 3: $4,000/month base plus commission. OTE $9,650 to $15,600. Month 4+: Commission only. At minimum close rates, the floor is $13,550/month. No base needed to hit that number. Month 8+ steady state: $19,238/month at minimum close rates. Income continues to grow as Stream A clients stack through their retention windows.

At full schedule you run 6 demos per day:

  • 2 Stream A, 4 Stream B.
  • Minimum close rates are 10% on shown Stream A calls and 15% on shown Stream B calls. These are the floor, not the target.

The Problems You'll Be Solving

Clinic owners come to us because they're losing ground in saturated markets.

  • Weak social proof.
  • Poor online authority.
  • Inconsistent branding.
  • Low consultation flow.
  • Low-quality leads.
  • Difficulty converting ad traffic.

Your job is to diagnose these problems on the call and position HighKey's solutions accordingly.

What We Expect

6 booked demos every business day, minimum. If you're under 6, you flag it that morning.

Post-call reporting in GHL and the BC Analytics Sheet within 15 minutes of every call ending. 2 call recordings submitted per week for review.

GHL pipeline updated every 2 weeks. Follow up every 48 to 72 hours on every committed lead, good lead that didn't close, and anything awaiting payment.

Contracts sent within 24 hours of every close.

This is a remote role but runs like an in-office job. All calls are on Google Meet with camera on and Fathom recording enabled. You need a professional setup, reliable internet, and a quiet environment.

Who This Is For

Minimum: 3+ years sales experience, 2+ years sales training, proven high-ticket closing experience. Background in medical, aesthetics, wellness, or health services is a strong plus. Preferred: agency sales, luxury client experience, medical or aesthetic industry background.

You sell outcomes. You stay composed under pressure. You take direct feedback and apply it. You manage your own follow-up without being asked.

Our Culture

Competitive. Fast-paced. High-accountability. Direct. Performance-driven.

We move fast, we expect professionalism, and we don't carry underperformers. If that's the environment you want, you'll fit here.

How to Apply

Apply through our portal. The first step is a short video submission. You'll be asked to answer this question on camera.

Salary: $3,000+ / month

About Aimtal LLC

Aimtal is a digital marketing agency headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts, with a team and clients located worldwide. Aimtal was co-founded in 2018 by Janet Mesh, Chief Executive Officer, and David Tapia, Chief Operating Officer. With a specialization in B2B marketing, Aimtal creates and executes digital marketing strategies that convert audiences into loyal customers and drive business growth. Our consultative, creative, and data-informed approach to marketing enables our team of experts to build a strategy and deliver measurable results that drive brand awareness and business growth.

Aimtal’s core values guide our approach to collaborating and communicating with our clients and team, enabling us to approach every day with empathy and excellence. Our core values are to communicate clearly, find a solution, understand the customer, keep an open mind, take the initiative, and be exceptional. Overall, our team works together to go above and beyond to support each other and our clients.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly-skilled Video Editor (Contractor) to join our network of creative contractors. As a contractor, you will be responsible for translating raw footage into high-impact, polished video assets that align with our clients' brand strategies. We are looking for a professional who possesses a "director’s eye" for storytelling and the technical mastery to execute projects independently from kickoff to final delivery.

This is a project-based contractor role. You will be expected to have access to and manage your own workload and editing software, delivering high-quality videos that meet specific technical requirements.

Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Post-Production: Take complete ownership of the editing process, including media organization, ingestion, assembly, color grading, and sound mixing.
  • Storytelling & Narrative: Splice raw footage from various sources to create cohesive, engaging stories that align with the project brief's narrative agenda.
  • Motion Graphics & Finishing: Create and integrate static and motion graphics, titling, and transitions to elevate the production value. Static assets and designs will always be provided by graphic designers on Figma.
  • Multi-Platform Optimization: Deliver final renders tailored to specific platforms (e.g., 9:16 for TikTok/Reels, 16:9 for YouTube, GIFs, and short-form teasers), ensuring all specs meet platform-specific best practices.
  • Asset Management: Independently source high-quality stock footage, music, and SFX that align with the creative direction of the video.
  • Quality Control: Perform rigorous quality control on all deliverables to ensure they are free of technical errors and align perfectly with brand guidelines before submission.
  • Technical Troubleshooting: Manage all software, hardware, and export configurations necessary to meet delivery deadlines. By standard, we usually work with After Effects and Adobe Premiere and you are required to have your own subscription of this software.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of video editing experience
  • A robust portfolio, reel, and/or sample work demonstrating high-level storytelling, pacing, and technical proficiency across various industries. SaaS (Software as a Service) and B2B (Business-to-Business) experience is preferred.
  • Expert-level command of Adobe Premiere Pro. Proficiency in Adobe Audition, Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator for asset preparation is required.
  • Experience editing audio, music, and incorporating sound effects
  • Intermediate to Advanced skill in motion graphics in After Effects (keyframing, typography, and 2D visual effects), and knowledge and experience in understanding motion design concepting and storyboarding are essential for this role
  • An understanding of video ad placement across marketing channels
  • Strong communication and organizational skills to manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Good time-management skills
  • Willing to take and provide feedback like a champ!
  • Experience within an agency, in-house agency, or post-production studio is a plus
  • At least 3-5+ years of experience in an agency or post-production house environment, managing multiple client projects simultaneously.
  • Communication: Ability to process creative briefs and feedback "like a pro," implementing revisions quickly and accurately with minimal back-and-forth. Depending on the complexity of the revision requests, the expected turnaround time is usually 2 working days or less.

Availability & Logistics

  • Immediate Start: We are looking for a contractor who has the availability to begin project work immediately.
  • Project Availability : Availability to scale hours up or down based on project volume.
  • Equipment: Must possess a high-end editing workstation capable of handling 4K footage and complex renders, along with a reliable, high-speed internet connection for large file transfers.

jobs.description:
Cyber Detection & Response Automation Engineer

The Cyber Detection & Response Automation Engineer is responsible for building the automation, orchestration, and AI-driven capabilities that power the organization's detection and response function. This role treats the SIEM as one component in a broader automation ecosystem — the primary focus is designing workflows, integrations, and intelligent tooling that reduce manual analyst effort, accelerate response, and scale detection coverage. The ideal candidate is an automation/orchestration engineer with a security background: comfortable building integrations and pipelines across multiple tools, applying AI/ML or LLM-assisted techniques to triage and enrichment, and engineering detection logic. This person will also maintain a working level of SIEM platform administration — data onboarding, health, and configuration — to support the automation and detection layers built on top of it, and will partner closely with Security Operations and the Detection Engineering Lead.

What you'll be doing:

  • Design, build, and maintain orchestration workflows and SOAR playbooks that automate triage, enrichment, containment, and response actions across the security tool stack.
  • Apply AI/ML and LLM-assisted techniques (e.g., automated alert summarization, natural-language investigation assistance, anomaly scoring) to reduce analyst workload and speed decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain Python-based integrations and APIs connecting the SIEM, SOAR, EDR, ticketing, threat intel, and cloud platforms into unified automated workflows.
  • Design, build, and tune SIEM correlation rules, alerts, and detection use cases mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, with an eye toward which detections can be paired with automated response.
  • Own core SIEM administration tasks needed to support automation and detection: data source onboarding, index/data model health, log ingestion monitoring, and configuration management.
  • Build and maintain custom field extractions, parsers, and content packs to ensure new data sources are automation- and detection-ready.
  • Continuously tune detections and automation logic to improve signal-to-noise ratio, reduce false positives, and reduce mean-time-to-respond (MTTR).
  • Create dashboards and reporting that measure automation coverage, orchestration reliability, AI-assisted triage accuracy, and detection effectiveness.
  • Apply CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices to manage detection content, playbooks, and integrations as versioned, testable code.
  • Evaluate and pilot new automation, orchestration, and AI tooling to expand the detection and response automation footprint.

What we'll want you to have:

  • 5+ years building automation, orchestration, or SOAR playbooks in a cyber security or SOC environment.
  • 3+ years of SIEM engineering or administration experience - data onboarding, correlation rule development, platform configuration.
  • Strong Python (or comparable scripting) skills; experience building APIs/integrations across security and IT tooling.
  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML or LLM-based tooling applied to security use cases - triage, summarization, enrichment, and/or anomaly detection; experience building such capability strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and experience mapping detections/automation to adversary tactics and techniques.
  • Experience with a SOAR or security orchestration platform (e.g., NG-SIEM Fusion, Splunk SOAR, Palo Alto XSOAR, Tines, or similar).
  • Cloud security experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including automation for ingesting and processing security data from cloud sources.
  • Experience with CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and version-controlling detection/automation content.
  • Familiarity with containerized and serverless environments and their automation/logging considerations.
  • SIEM, SOAR, or security automation platform certification preferred.
  • Regulatory compliance experience a plus.

What You Wil Do:

We are seeking an experienced Identity & Access Management (IAM) Leader to build and lead our enterprise IAM function. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO), this role is responsible for IAM strategy, architecture, delivery, and operations across workforce, customer, and non-human identities.

This leader will define the IAM vision and roadmap, oversee key identity transformation initiatives, manage vendors and delivery partners, and lead a globally distributed team in a complex, matrixed environment.

Strategy, Vision & Organizational Leadership

  • Define and lead the enterprise IAM strategy, operating model, and roadmap aligned to business, risk, and regulatory priorities. Build and scale the IAM organization to include team structure and hiring plans.

  • Partner across Cybersecurity, IT, HR, Legal, Privacy, Risk, Internal Audit, and business teams to deliver consistent identity outcomes.

  • Oversee major IAM transformation initiatives, including program execution and budget accountability.

  • Establish metrics and reporting to demonstrate program maturity, business value, and risk reduction.

Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)

  • Lead the design and maturity of Identity Governance and Administration capabilities, including lifecycle management, access requests, certifications, role management, and separation of duties.

  • Drive the strategy, implementation, and maturation of enterprise IGA capabilities using platforms such as SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, or similar solutions.

  • Advance least-privilege and Zero Trust principles across enterprise applications, platforms, and cloud environments.

  • Oversee identity lifecycle management for workforce, contractors, partners, and non-human identities.

Privileged Access Management (PAM)

  • Lead the strategy and maturity of the firm’s Privileged Access Management program, including vaulting, credential management, session controls, and privileged access governance.

  • Provide strategic leadership for PAM capabilities and related tooling, including platforms such as Delinea, CyberArk, or similar solutions.

  • Establish standards for privileged access, secrets management, and just-in-time elevation across human and machine identities.

  • Reduce standing privilege across hybrid environments and track progress through measurable controls.

Authentication, SSO & Federation

  • Lead enterprise authentication and access capabilities, including SSO, MFA, conditional access, federation, and modern authentication methods.

  • Support modern identity and access patterns through technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID and related federation and access governance capabilities.

  • Support secure identity patterns for employees, clients, partners, and external platforms as needed.

Cloud & Workload Identity

  • Drive identity standards for cloud and workload access across Guidehouse’s hybrid and multi-cloud environments.

  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams to embed identity and access controls into platforms and delivery processes.

  • Establish guardrails and monitoring for entitlements and permissions across enterprise technology environments.

Risk, Compliance & Audit

  • Align IAM capabilities to security, compliance, and audit requirements across applicable regulatory and control frameworks.

  • Partner with compliance and audit stakeholders to support control evidence, remediation, and sustainable governance processes.

  • Support identity requirements for both internal operations and client-serving environments as needed.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team spanning IAM architecture, engineering, operations, and governance.

  • Build a culture of accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.

  • Represent the IAM function with senior leadership and key stakeholders across the enterprise.

What You Will Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree and minimum 12 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity with at least 8+ years focused on Identity & Access Management, and 7+ years in a people-leadership capacity or 16 years of equivalent professional experience in lieu of degree.

  • Proven experience building or maturing an enterprise IAM function in a complex, global organization.

  • Demonstrated success leading in a matrixed environment and partnering across technology, security, and business teams.

  • Strong experience with modern IAM technologies and concepts, including IGA, PAM, SSO, MFA, federation, and lifecycle management, with hands-on experience leading or supporting platforms such as SailPoint, Microsoft Entra ID Governance, Delinea, CyberArk, and similar tools.

  • Experience leading complex, multi-year IAM transformation programs with cross-functional teams and external partners.

  • Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks relevant to IAM programs.

  • Experience supporting identity requirements in regulated environments, including public sector or highly governed industries.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • U.S. Citizenship required. Must reside in the United States.

What Would Be Nice to Have:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Experience in a professional services or other complex enterprise environment.

  • Relevant industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or IAM-related certifications.

The annual salary range for this position is $171,000.00-$285,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

jobs.description:
Description

The Clinical Data Coder is primarily responsible for providing support to activities related to coding of Clinical data for ongoing clinical studies. The Clinical Data Coder will also participate in various clinical data management activities required to ensure that data captured are collected, managed and reported clearly, accurately and securely. In addition, this position is required to conduct all these activities in conformance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry guidelines, and Indero standard operating procedures (SOPs) while respecting Indero’s commitment to sponsor’s requirements and timelines.

More specifically, the Clinical Data Coder must:

  • Lead and perform accurate coding of medical terms and medications using MedDRA, WHO Drug, and internal conventions.
  • Oversee the setup of the coding module for assigned studies, ensuring correct configurations and workflows.
  • Define, document, and manage coding conventions, synonym lists and ensure consistent application across studies.
  • Validate sponsor coding licenses.
  • Act as the Lead Coder, coordinating coding activities across multiple studies simultaneously.
  • Manage coding priorities, balancing workload across timelines and studies.
  • Provide input to the Coding section of Data Management Plans.
  • Oversee and perform dictionary up-versioning and related upgrade activities.
  • Validate and test coding setups, programming of coding reports, and related database checks.
  • Support data review activities and resolve data clarifications in a timely manner.
  • Maintain effective communication with Data Management Leads, CRAs, and other stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or educational equivalence in pharmacy, life sciences or related field or medical, nursing qualification with 2 years relevant experience or equivalent combination of education, training and experience;
  • Thorough knowledge of Medical Terminology and Medical Dictionaries used for coding (e.g. MedDRA, WHODD etc.);
  • Experience working with clinical trials or within the pharmaceutical environment is preferred;
  • Demonstrate understanding and experience in query management process;
  • Ability to work flexibly on simultaneous projects and proactively manage time to meet own deadlines;
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills;
  • Ability to work in a global team environment;
  • Good organizational and analytical skills and high attention to detail;
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines.

Our company

﻿The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule
  • Permanent full-time position
  • Company benefits package
  • Ongoing learning and development
  • Home-based position

About Indero

A Global Clinical Leader in Dermatology and rheumatology!

﻿Formerly known as Innovaderm, Indero is a world-renowned expert and clinical research leader in dermatology. We have more than two decades of experience serving a broad range of indications, patient populations, administration routes, and drug classes, and a global footprint.

﻿Indero is a dual-focus CRO for dermatology and rheumatology, with 25+ years’ experience in clinical research and trial delivery. Our full-service approach – which includes everything from protocol design and patient recruitment to trial monitoring and biometrics – provides biotech and pharmaceutical sponsors with the rigorous scientific foundation and tailored expertise their studies need to reach the finish line efficiently and effectively. With capabilities in North America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Latin America; vast, continuously growing relationships with investigators and patients; and a dedicated research clinic through which we design and execute our own studies, Indero is the ideal CRO partner for clinical needs at global scale.

﻿Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

﻿Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Canada.

Description de poste

Le codeur de données cliniques est principalement responsable de soutenir les activités liées au codage des données cliniques dans le cadre des études cliniques en cours. Il participe également à diverses activités de gestion des données cliniques nécessaires afin de garantir que les données saisies sont recueillies, gérées et rapportées de façon claire, exacte et sécurisée.

De plus, le titulaire de ce poste doit réaliser l’ensemble de ces activités conformément aux exigences réglementaires applicables, aux lignes directrices de l’industrie et aux procédures opératoires normalisées (SOP) d’Indero, tout en respectant l’engagement d’Indero à répondre aux exigences et aux échéanciers des promoteurs.

Plus précisément, le codeur de données cliniques doit :

  • Diriger et effectuer avec précision le codage des termes médicaux et des médicaments à l’aide de MedDRA, de WHO Drug et des conventions internes;
  • Superviser la configuration du module de codage pour les études qui lui sont attribuées, en veillant à l’exactitude des paramètres et des flux de travail;
  • Définir, documenter et gérer les conventions de codage et les listes de synonymes, et veiller à leur application uniforme dans l’ensemble des études;

jobs.title: Marketing Lead, Europe
jobs.excerpt: At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions.
jobs.description:
At In Tandem, we build technology that helps families manage everyday routines and navigate life’s biggest transitions. Through our four brands—OurFamilyWizard, Cozi, FamilyWall, and Custody Navigator—we help families stay organized, communicate well, and foster healthy childhoods.
We believe technology should strengthen relationships and make daily coordination less complicated. Everything we create is designed to lighten the mental load, reduce conflict, and support families through big and small moments.
If you want your work to make a real difference in the daily lives of parents and kids, In Tandem is the place where your impact will truly matter.

OurFamilyWizard is the platform separated and co-parenting families rely on to communicate, share schedules, and manage expenses with less conflict. Millions of parents use it, and family-law professionals and courts recommend it. OurFamilyWizard is already live in France, with strong early results and ambitions to expand across Europe. We’re looking for the person who will build on those results and lead OurFamilyWizard’s marketing across the region.
This is the first dedicated marketing role for the European market, and it’s a big one. Starting with France, you’ll own how OurFamilyWizard grows across both sides of our model, in a market with its own legal system, its own vocabulary for separation, and its own ideas about co-parenting. On the professional side (B2B2C), you’ll market to the family-law attorneys, mediators, and notaires who refer parents to us, so that more of them do. On the consumer side (B2C), you’ll drive the acquisition funnel that turns co-parents into subscribers, working directly with the D2C leads who run that engine for us in the US. Our sales team in France, which owns the professional relationships, reports to our Chief Revenue Officer, and you’ll work hand in hand with them: you generate the demand and give them the tools to close it. At the start, you’ll be hands-on across all of it. As the market grows, you’ll build the marketing team to grow with it.

What you'll accomplish:

  • Lead the marketing strategy for Europe, starting with France. Decide how OurFamilyWizard reaches families and professionals in each market, agree on the acquisition goals with leadership, and be the person accountable for hitting them.
  • Grow the professional channel through marketing (B2B2C). Family-law attorneys, mediators, and notaires are how many families find us. Your job is to reach them and make them advocates—through content, events, co-marketing, referral programs, and professional partnerships—so they send more parents our way. In France you’ll do this alongside our in-country sales team, who hold the direct relationships. In new markets, you’ll help define what that channel looks like before there’s a team on the ground.
  • Drive consumer acquisition across Europe (B2C). You’re responsible for the funnel in each market—the App Store, paid acquisition, partnerships, and content—starting with France, and you’re genuinely good at it. Our Growth, Lifecycle, Content, Design and Product leads in the US run a strong D2C engine, and you’ll work with them closely, adapting what already performs, and sharing what Europe needs that they don’t have yet. You set the direction, make the calls, and when you need to, you get into the tools and execute the work yourself.
  • Make the work feel local, not translated. Decide how OurFamilyWizard talks about separation and co-parenting in each market, starting with France—the vocabulary families actually use, what reads as supportive rather than intrusive, and how professionals there expect to be approached. Brief the US teams on that context so what they build for Europe lands.
  • Be the marketing voice of Europe inside In Tandem. Bring these markets back to product, marketing, and leadership, and make the case for what the region needs to succeed.
  • Build the marketing team as the region earns it.

Who you are:

  • A strong marketer in your own right. Not someone who only directs marketing, but someone who can plan a campaign, build the content, and read the funnel yourself. You’ll have strong D2C partners in the US, and Europe’s marketing is yours to shape and execute alongside them.
  • Comfortable on both sides—B2B2C and B2C. You can market to professionals so they refer and recommend, and you can run direct consumer acquisition. You’ve done both, and you’re not precious about which one a given week demands.
  • Experienced marketing through professional or partner channels. You’ve reached an audience by winning over the people they trust - legal, healthcare, financial, or similar fields where referrals and recommendations drive growth.
  • Deeply grounded in French family culture, and able to build that same depth in the next market. You understand how families here think about separation, custody, and asking for help: what still carries stigma, what earns trust, and how the legal system and the professionals in it shape those decisions. You can tell when a message built elsewhere won’t work here and explain why.
  • Someone who has built something from the beginning. You’ve stood up marketing in a new market or region, product line, or company. You’re strategic enough to set the direction, hands-on enough to execute it before there’s a team behind you.
  • A clear communicator in both French and English. French fluency is essential, and you’ll work every day with a team in the US and UK.
It’s a plus if you’ve worked in legaltech, in family or parenting products, or in a two-sided consumer subscription business—and even better if you already know the French family-law or mediation world.

What you bring:

  • Around 8+ years in marketing for digital or consumer products, with real range across both channel/partner marketing and direct consumer acquisition.
  • A track record of launching something and growing it, with numbers you’re proud of.
  • Hands-on command of the core toolkit—paid acquisition, App Store / organic, content, CRM and lifecycle, and the analytics to know what’s working.
  • Experience building the first marketing processes, partnerships, or channels somewhere, rather than stepping into a machine that already runs.
  • Real time living and working in France, with a current read on how family life, separation, and parenting are talked about here—not market exposure from the outside. If you’ve also marketed in another European market, better still.
