This position requires a large amount of time in front of a computer with multiple monitors; must be able to sit or stand for long periods of time. Must be able to efficiently access and interpret information on computer screens, documents, and reports.

jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves

We're building competitive-programming problems and their automatic graders (test cases + checkers) used to train advanced AI coding models. You'll create problems, write both correct and deliberately-wrong solutions, and design the tough test cases that catch subtly-broken code. Your work is what makes the training signal trustworthy.

To apply, share: your competitive-programming handle(s) + current/peak rating, any problem-setting experience, and IOI/ICPC/olympiad history.

What you'll do

  • Write original algorithmic problems — clear statement, sound constraints, an intended solution;
  • Write correct solutions in C++ and Python;
  • Write realistic wrong solutions (common mistakes) to test against;
  • Build and harden test cases: generators, edge cases, stress and "hacking" tests;
  • Write checkers/interactors (testlib) for problems with more than one valid answer;
  • Confirm the quality bar: correct solutions pass, wrong ones fail, within time limits.

What we look for

  • Strong competitive programming background, shown by a public profile — a Codeforces rating (see levels below), OR an IOI / ICPC / national-olympiad record;
  • Fluent contest C++ (STL, complexity); comfortable writing Python;
  • Can explain why a solution is wrong and build an input that breaks it;
  • Strong written English (C1+).

Levels (by Codeforces rating, or equivalent olympiad achievement):

  • Associate — 1700–2100 (Expert / Candidate Master): easier problems;
  • Expert — 2200–2600 (Master / Grandmaster): harder problems
  • Senior / Reviewer — 2600+ (Int'l Grandmaster) or IOI/ICPC medalist: hardest problems + quality review.

Nice to have

  • IOI / ICPC alumni and top competitive programmers especially encouraged to apply;
  • Experience setting or testing problems for real contests (Codeforces rounds, ICPC, national olympiads, online judges);
  • Testlib experience (checkers, validators, generators);
  • Experience creating data for LLM code benchmarks or similar RL / evaluation datasets.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks must be submitted by the deadline and meet the listed acceptance criteria to be accepted.

Compensation

Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $90/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Technical Product Manager for AI Security Products

Remote [within the US]

ABOUT THE ROLE:

HiddenLayer is entering an exciting new chapter in our company history and we are seeking a Technical Product Manager for our AI Security products to drive the development of a groundbreaking cybersecurity platform to secure and protect against adversarial AI attacks. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to work with industry pioneers in data science and artificial intelligence threat research in a fast-paced emerging market.

As a Product Manager with a strong background in cybersecurity and AI, you will play a crucial role in the development, enhancement, and delivery of HiddenLayer’s AISec Platform to protect and defend generative AI and agentic systems against cybersecurity threats and attacks.

WHO WE ARE:

HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

You will be responsible for translating customer needs, technical insights, and the evolving Adversarial AI threat landscape into actionable product capabilities and detection techniques. Your exceptional understanding of both machine learning and cybersecurity will allow you to effectively guide cross-functional teams, bridging the gap between sales engineering, product development, data science, threat research, and professional services.

  • Product Roadmap Planning: Manage, maintain, and prioritize HiddenLayer’s backlog of product and feature ideas
  • Product Execution: Collaborate with internal stakeholders (engineering, data science, and threat research) to define requirements and deliver high-quality product capabilities and user experience
  • Adversarial AI Threat Landscape: Maintaining vigilance and knowledge of the Adversarial AI Threat Landscape and MITRE ATLAS to define and prioritize detection requirements for HiddenLayer’s products
  • Market Analysis: Conduct comprehensive market research and competitive analysis to identify emerging trends, opportunities, and potential threats in the machine learning and cybersecurity landscape
  • Customer Insights: Engage with customers and gather feedback to understand their pain points, requirements, and preferences to drive product improvements.
  • Requirements Definition: Clearly define product requirements, use cases, and specifications, collaborating with engineering, data science, and threat research teams to ensure the feasibility and effectiveness of solutions

Go-to-Market Launches: Coordinate product launches and develop effective go-to-market strategies, collaborating with marketing, sales, and support teams to drive product adoption and success in the market.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Candidates could be:
    • Technical Product Managers in data science or machine learning operations who seek to delve into cybersecurity
    • Technical Product Managers in cybersecurity who have data science or AI operations experience
    • Former Data Scientists, AI Engineers, or developers who want to make a career pivot into product management
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
  • In-depth knowledge of AI techniques, algorithms, frameworks, and AI Operation tools.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles, best practices, and industry standards.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including engineering, data science, threat research, marketing, sales, and support.
  • Proficient in Agile product development methodologies and project management tools.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to analyze complex technical challenges and propose effective solutions.
  • Prior experience in developing and/or launching successful machine learning and/or cybersecurity products is a plus.
  • Flexible and adaptable self-starter with strong relationship building skills
  • Collaborative and team oriented attitude
  • Intellectual curiosity, humility, accountability, and positive approach

WHY HIDDENLAYER?

We’re moving at (what feels like) the speed of light. HiddenLayer is a venture-backed company and recently closed a $50M funding round led by M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and Moore Strategic Ventures.

Attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. That’s why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

  • Fully Remote: We are a completely remote global team. Though we’re distributed, we are intentional about getting the team together a couple of times a year. We offer a generous stipend for your home office setup, annual upgrades to ensure you have a comfortable workspace and a monthly stipend for internet/phone expenses.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits: Better than your average startup healthcare benefits. With five options to choose from, of which are fully subsidized by HiddenLayer, we offer a variety of options to fit each person’s needs. We also offer vision, dental, and 401k offerings.
  • Flexible Time Off: Enjoy unlimited and flexible time off for all salaried employees, in addition to 15 paid company holidays.
  • Commitment to Learning and Development: We support personal growth and education through a dedicated L&D fund that can be used for training, conferences, certifications and industry events.
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We are committed to building a diverse team with individuals from various backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

To learn more about HiddenLayer visitHiddenLayer and follow us on LinkedIn or Twitter.

HiddenLayer is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

jobs.description:
Mindrift is looking for a highly skilled Brand Designer to join the Tendem project (**) and create strong visual identities for real-world brands and products. In this role, you'll apply your expertise in brand strategy, visual identity, and design systems to create cohesive, modern, and impactful brand assets. This part-time remote opportunity is ideal for creative professionals with hands-on experience in brand asset creation, visual identity development, and maintaining brand consistency.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Brand Designer, your focus will be on brand asset creation, visual identity, and brand consistency. We need a core specialist dedicated to building a strong visual foundation. You will serve as the architect of the brand identity, modernizing aesthetics and ensuring that all visual touchpoints look cohesive across various mediums using industry-standard design tools.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop foundational brand assets, including logos, complete visual identities, and comprehensive color schemes.
  • Create, systematically organize, and deliver necessary variations of core brand elements.
  • Act as the strict gatekeeper for brand consistency across all internal and external materials, including pitch decks and social media kits.
  • Build scalable, long-lasting visual systems that align with modern design standards.
  • Enforce design quality through cross-platform validation, ensuring brand aesthetics translate flawlessly across both digital and print mediums.

How to get started

Apply, pass qualification(s), and start contributing to projects aligned with your expertise — on your own schedule.

Educational qualifications

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in brand design, graphic design, art direction, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, Communication Design, or related creative fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on brand identity creation, logo design, and comprehensive brand guidelines. We are looking for specialists with a deep understanding of how core branding translates seamlessly across different digital and print mediums. A strategic, detail-obsessed approach and the ability to work independently to build long-lasting visual systems are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Brand Identity Creation: Expertise in building foundational assets from scratch, including scalable logos, distinct color palettes, and typography systems.
  • Design Tools: Deep proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign) and Figma for crafting and managing core design assets.
  • Cross-Medium Adaptation: Proven ability to translate brand DNA perfectly across varied formats, from digital social media kits to corporate pitch decks and print materials.
  • Brand System Architecture: Strong organizational skills to develop clear brand guidelines, style guides, and structured asset libraries for wider team use.

Additional requirements

  • A strategic, detail-obsessed mindset focused on long-term brand equity.
  • Strong dedication to visual consistency and functioning as a true brand gatekeeper.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver high-quality assets.
  • Portfolio showcasing branding work (logos, identity systems, guidelines) must be included in the CV
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $34 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

jobs.description:
Join us as we transform immunology and deliver medicines that help autoimmune patients get their lives back. argenx is preparing for multi-dimensional expansion to reach more patients through a rich pipeline of differentiated assets, led by VYVGART, our first-in-class neonatal Fc receptor blocker approved for the treatment of gMG, and with the potential to treat patients across dozens of severe autoimmune diseases.


We are building a new kind of biotech company, one that maintains its roots as a science-based start-up and pushes our commitment to innovate across all corners of our business. We strive to inspire and grow our company, our partnerships, our science, and our people, because when we do, we deliver more for patients.

Join argenx

At argenx, we build our culture from the collective power of the team and the knowledge that together, we are better. If you are entrepreneurial, curious and committed to make a difference for patients and thrive on creating solutions for rare autoimmune diseases, then argenx is for you.
Next to a competitive salary with extensive benefits, we offer you the chance to grow and be a part of a team driven by purpose, creativity, innovation and science.

For the expansion of our international Digital Technology team, argenx is looking for a Global DT Lead Development.

PURPOSE OF THE FUNCTION

This role will act as the strategic technology leader and primary business partner for Development capabilities within Digital Technology. It is accountable for defining and executing the technology vision, roadmap, and value delivery that enable clinical development, trial execution, and data-driven decision-making across the portfolio.

The Global DT Lead Development translates scientific and operational development needs into a scalable and future-fit digital ecosystem. This role drives innovation, ensures regulatory-compliant solutions, and champions co-creation to accelerate the delivery of therapies to patients.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define the technology vision and multi-year roadmap for Development in alignment with R&D and clinical strategy
  • Act as the strategic interface between DT and Development leadership, ensuring strong alignment on priorities and outcomes
  • Govern the portfolio of Development technology initiatives, from ideation and prioritization to value realization and benefit tracking
  • Lead the delivery of a coherent digital ecosystem supporting clinical trials, data platforms, and Development operations
  • Act as senior advisor on Development technologies (e.g., clinical systems, data platforms), translating complex scientific and operational needs into scalable solutions
  • Ensure all solutions meet regulatory requirements (e.g., GxP, data integrity, validation) and adhere to quality standards
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in Development processes through digital capabilities and data leverage
  • Foster strong cross-functional collaboration across Development, Data, Regulatory, Quality, and external partners
  • Lead complex programs and manage dependencies across a global and matrixed environment
  • Champion a culture of co-creation, accountability, and outcomes-driven delivery within the DT Development capability
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing global dt development team, including talent development, performance management, and succession planning
  • Shape and embed the operating model for development within the dt organization (ways of working, governance, value tracking)
  • Build and maintain strategic partnerships with development technology vendors, ensuring a deep understanding of their capabilities, product roadmaps, and innovation agendas to inform technology decisions and maximize business value.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

  • Deep understanding of clinical development processes, including clinical trials, study execution, and regulatory requirements
  • Strong experience with Development-related platforms (e.g., clinical systems, data platforms, analytics environments)
  • Proven ability to define and execute multi-year technology strategies and roadmaps in a complex, regulated environment
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to translate complex scientific and operational challenges into actionable technology solutions
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leadership in global organizations
  • Ability to operate in a high level of ambiguity and drive clarity, alignment, and decisions
  • Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional, global teams, fostering collaboration and accountability
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills in a multi-cultural environment
  • Strong focus on outcomes, value realization, and continuous improvement

EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE

  • Master’s degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
  • 10+ years of experience in Digital Technology / IT within a biopharmaceutical or life sciences environment
  • Strong experience supporting Clinical Development, R&D, or related GxP-regulated domains
  • Proven track record in leading large-scale technology portfolios and transformation programs
  • Experience working with senior stakeholders in Development, R&D, or Clinical Operations within a global organization
  • Strong people leadership capabilities, with experience building and scaling global teams
  • Ability to work collaboratively and effectively together within cross-functional teams and networks
  • Demonstrated communication skills, within a multi-cultural and multi-lingual global environment
  • Derives energy from operating in a dynamic, complex, fast-moving, and frequently changing business environment
  • Demonstrable experience with project management, proactive planning, priority setting, and securing alignment
  • Passionate and prepared to lead and contribute to our culture, which is driven by our corporate values of co-creation, innovation, empowerment, excellence, and humility.

OTHER

  • Min 20% TRAVEL REQUIRED

jobs.excerpt: Clio es líder mundial en tecnología de IA legal, empoderando a los profesionales del derecho y a los bufetes de abogados de todos los tamaños para trabajar de forma más inteligente, rápida y segura.
jobs.description:
Clio es líder mundial en tecnología de IA legal, empoderando a los profesionales del derecho y a los bufetes de abogados de todos los tamaños para trabajar de forma más inteligente, rápida y segura.


Estamos transformando la experiencia legal para todos mejorando la vida de los profesionales del derecho a la vez que aumentamos el acceso a la justicia.


Resumen:

Estamos buscando un Account Executive con experiencia en el sector legal y un fuerte interés en la tecnología, enfocado en impulsar nuestra expansión en México.

La misión principal de este puesto será colaborar con cuentas estratégicas y de mid-market, incluyendo bufetes de abogados medianos a grandes y departamentos legales corporativos clave, para optimizar sus operaciones y mejorar la eficiencia mediante la implementación de nuestras soluciones de vanguardia.

Gestionarás el ciclo completo de venta consultiva para Vincent AI, generando un pipeline de alta calidad y cerrando acuerdos que transformen los procesos legales.

Requisitos principales

  • Licenciatura o grado universitario en Derecho (altamente valorado y preferido), o campos relacionados como Administración de Empresas, Negocios o Ingeniería con una fuerte orientación legal.

  • 2–5 años de experiencia en ventas consultivas B2B/SaaS, idealmente vendiendo soluciones tecnológicas a bufetes de abogados, departamentos legales o profesionales del derecho.

  • Trayectoria comprobada en prospección activa, cualificación de leads complejos y cierre de acuerdos.

  • Experiencia trabajando con cuentas estratégicas y de mid-market, gestionando procesos de toma de decisiones con múltiples partes interesadas (multi-stakeholder).

  • Inglés intermedio a avanzado (escrito y conversacional; interacción frecuente con clientes internacionales).

  • Mentalidad sólida orientada a resultados, experiencia en la gestión del pipeline (herramientas CRM como Salesforce o HubSpot) e historial de superación de objetivos.

  • Valor adicional: Experiencia previa utilizando o vendiendo herramientas de legaltech, IA o investigación jurídica.

Responsabilidades clave

  • Liderar el ciclo completo de ventas para Vincent AI: prospección estratégica → demos consultivas → negociación → cierre y expansión dentro de bufetes de abogados y departamentos legales de tamaño mediano a grande.

  • Generar y cualificar un pipeline de alta calidad dentro del sector legal mexicano (cuentas estratégicas y de mid-market).

  • Desarrollar una comprensión profunda de los puntos de dolor (pain points) de los abogados (eficiencia, precisión, cumplimiento) y posicionar a Vincent AI como la solución que transforma su trabajo diario.

  • Construir relaciones de confianza a largo plazo con socios, socios directores (managing partners) y directores jurídicos (general counsels).

  • Colaborar con los equipos de marketing, customer success, producto y el equipo global de Clio/vLex para maximizar la tasa de éxito (win rate) y la satisfacción del cliente.

  • Mantener el CRM actualizado con precisión y proporcionar pronósticos de ventas (sales forecasting) fiables.

  • Cumplir y superar objetivos comerciales ambiciosos, contribuyendo al liderazgo de Clio vLex en IA legal en toda la región.

Lo que encontrarás aquí:


La compensación es uno de los componentes principales del Programa de Total Rewards de Clio. Hemos desarrollado una serie de programas y procesos para garantizar que estamos creando prácticas salariales justas y competitivas que formen la base de nuestra cultura de Personas y Alto Rendimiento.


Algunos aspectos destacados de nuestro programa de Total Rewards incluyen:

  • Salario competitivo y equitativo.
  • Los empleados tienen derecho a hasta 6 días de permiso administrativo al año para gestiones personales con la documentación válida correspondiente.
    • No se aplica a bajas médicas, bajas por maternidad/paternidad o permisos por fallecimiento de un familiar.
  • Los empleados que cumplan los requisitos reciben una asignación por teletrabajo no salarial de 575 MXN mensuales, abonada a través de tarjetas Sivale.
  • Programa de reconocimiento Clioversary con menciones especiales a los 3, 5, 7, 10 años y en adelante.

Diversidad, Inclusión, Pertenencia y Equidad (DIBE) y Accesibilidad


Nuestro equipo se muestra con su identidad auténtica y está unido por nuestra misión. Estamos dedicados a la diversidad, la equidad y la inclusión. Nos enorgullecemos de construir y fomentar un entorno en el que nuestros equipos se sientan incluidos, valorados y capacitados para realizar el mejor trabajo de sus carreras, desde cualquier lugar donde elijan conectarse. Creemos que las diferentes perspectivas, habilidades, antecedentes y experiencias dan como resultado equipos de alto rendimiento y una mejor innovación. Estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de empleo y animamos a candidatos de todos los orígenes a presentar su solicitud.


Clio proporciona adaptaciones de accesibilidad durante el proceso de selección. Si necesitas alguna adaptación, por favor háznoslo saber y trabajaremos contigo para satisfacer tus necesidades.


Obtén más información sobre nuestra cultura en clio.com/careers.

Somos una empresa de IA de Personas y Alto Rendimiento, lo que significa que utilizamos la inteligencia artificial para mejorar todas nuestras operaciones. En el reclutamiento, la IA nos ayuda a agilizar el proceso para una mayor eficiencia. Sin embargo, hemos diseñado nuestros sistemas para garantizar que un humano siempre revise los resultados generados por la IA, y nunca tomamos decisiones de contratación automatizadas.

  • Develops strategic account plans in partnership with the Integrated Account Management (IAM) Account Executive teams and executes medical activities in alignment with agreed plan

  • Serves as the primary resource for market dynamics within the territory to understand decision makers’ evolving information needs to feed into the ongoing value-proposition development process for oncology product and non-product offerings

Summary of Position:

The Sr. Product Owner, Care Coordination Services (CCS) is the day-to-day owner of the product backlog for Verisma's Care Coordination product line. Reporting into Product Management, the Sr. Product Owner translates product strategy and customer requirements — including the build-out of net-new products such as our Forms solution and Referral Management platform — into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and prioritized sprint work that engineering can execute against. This is an execution-focused, team-facing role. The Sr. Product Owner partners closely with engineering, QA, design, and product management to keep the build cycle moving: refining the backlog, clarifying requirements, accepting delivered work, and removing ambiguity. While the Product Manager owns the product vision, roadmap, market positioning, and pricing, the Sr. Product Owner owns how that vision gets built — sprint by sprint — and is accountable for the quality and predictability of what the scrum team delivers.

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Owning, refining, and prioritizing the CCS product backlog in support of the roadmap
  • Writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and accepting completed work
  • Acting as the primary point of contact for engineering on requirements questions during the sprint
  • Partnering with Product Management on discovery, customer feedback, and release readiness for new CCS products
  • Duties & Responsibilities
  • Own and groom the CCS product backlog: write user stories, define acceptance criteria, attach supporting context, and keep the backlog ranked against the roadmap priorities set by Product Management
  • Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standup, sprint review, and retrospective ceremonies as the product representative on the scrum team
  • Translate roadmap initiatives — including the Forms solution, Referral Management platform, and other CCS programs — into release plans, epics, features, and stories that engineering can size and commit to
  • Make day-to-day prioritization and trade-off decisions inside the sprint; escalate scope or roadmap-level decisions to the Product Manager
  • Accept completed user stories against acceptance criteria and confirm release readiness
  • Partner with engineering and QA to triage defects, clarify edge cases, and resolve ambiguity quickly so the team is never blocked on requirements
  • Coordinate with UX/design to ensure flows and mockups are in place ahead of development
  • Support Product Management on customer discovery, user interviews, and validation sessions — bringing back insights that refine the backlog
  • Maintain product documentation: PRDs (in partnership with the PM), user stories, release notes, internal training materials, and post-launch updates
  • Support release activities including UAT coordination, customer pilot management, and internal enablement of sales, implementation, and customer success teams
  • Track and report sprint and release metrics (velocity, throughput, defect rates, scope changes); surface risks early
  • Contribute to competitive and market awareness by reviewing customer feedback, support tickets, and field input, and routing relevant signals to Product Management
  • Act as a connective tissue across product, engineering, QA, design, customer success, and implementation for the CCS product line
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, and purpose-built product/AI tooling) to accelerate product operations — drafting and refining user stories, synthesizing customer feedback, generating release notes and documentation, analyzing support and usage data, and speeding up backlog grooming
  • Perform other appropriate duties, as assigned, to meet the needs of the department and the company
  • Live by and promote Verisma Core Values

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Computer Science, or a related field, preferred
  • Minimum of 3-5 years' experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role on a software product team
  • Demonstrated experience owning a product backlog in an Agile/Scrum environment — writing user stories, defining acceptance criteria, and partnering with engineering through delivery
  • 2+ years of experience in healthcare technology, with preference for Care Coordination, Health Information Management, Release of Information, EHR/EMR, referral management, clinical workflow, or related domains
  • Hands-on experience with backlog and project tooling such as Azure DevOps, Jira, or equivalent
  • Competency in Microsoft applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Strong analytical skills — able to break complex problems into well-scoped stories and use data to inform prioritization
  • Excellent teamwork skills and proven ability to collaborate with engineers, designers, QA, and product managers
  • Ability to extract requirements from internal business stakeholders and customers and translate them into clear, testable stories
  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills, with strong documentation discipline
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to perform comfortably in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment, including environments where products are being built from 0 to 1
  • Ability to work independently as a self-starter while taking direction from Product Management
  • Must be able to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed, for customer visits, discovery, and team collaboration

The Director of Advocacy Operations & Enterprise Incident Management leads the organization responsible for protecting customer experience and business operations during periods of operational risk or disruption. This leader oversees the teams responsible for enterprise incident command, executive escalations, critical account recovery, customer action plans, and operational governance. The remit spans all classes of incident: product and platform outages, cyber security events, physical site and facilities emergencies, business continuity disruptions, and third-party or supply-chain failures.

The role establishes the operating model, develops leadership talent, and drives cross-functional accountability across Success, Support, Product, Engineering, Security, IT, Services, Legal, Facilities, Corporate Communications, and Sales to ensure customer and business issues are resolved quickly and systemic problems are eliminated.

  • Maintain the activation model, on-call rosters, and escalation trees that ensure the correct individuals join the bridge within defined response times.

  • Establish a unified severity taxonomy, response frameworks, communication standards, and executive reporting that apply consistently across incident types, so that a given severity level means the same thing whether the event is an outage, a security breach, or a site evacuation.

  • Drive customer-facing coordination during critical service events.

  • Coordinate incident communications with Corporate Communications, Legal, and Support across internal, customer, and, where required, regulatory audiences.

  • Establish severity definitions, response frameworks, communication standards, and executive reporting.

  • Drive post-incident reviews and corrective action plans.

Executive Escalations

  • Act as the single operational owner coordinating cross-functional response teams.

  • Ensure executives have clear visibility into customer impact, recovery actions, and commitments.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop standardized playbooks, workflows, and operating rhythms.

  • Implement reporting to identify systemic causes of escalations and incidents.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring issues.

Business Continuity and Crisis Readiness

  • Own the enterprise incident response playbooks for each incident class, developed jointly with the accountable functional owner.

  • Run tabletop exercises and simulations across incident classes on a defined annual cycle, and convert the findings into playbook and readiness improvements.

  • Maintain the readiness of the command structure, including rosters, contact trees, bridge infrastructure, and incident tooling.

  • Interface with the crisis management team and executive staff during high-severity events.

Operational Excellence

  • Develop standardized playbooks, workflows, and operating rhythms.

  • Implement reporting to identify systemic causes of escalations and incidents.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce recurring issues.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Customer Success, Support, Product, Engineering, Sales, and Renewal teams.

  • Influence prioritization of systemic customer-impacting issues.

  • Escalate organizational barriers preventingtimely customer resolution.

Measures of Success

  • Reduction in executive escalations.

  • Time to resolution for critical incidents.

  • Time to executive response.

  • Time to bridge activation, and time to full assembly of the required responders at the required seniority.

  • Incident command coverage: the percentage of qualifying incidents run under the formal command model.

  • Communications timeliness against severity-defined service levels, across internal, customer, and regulatory audiences.

jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of the role

We are seeking a Principal Security Researcher to join ourApplication Security Team to conduct cutting-edge security research on GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps capabilities. As GitLab transforms software development through intelligent collaboration between developers and specialized AI agents, we need security researchers who can proactively identify and validate vulnerabilities before they impact our platform or customers.

In this role, you'll be at the forefront of security research, working with our GitLab DevSecOps platform, Duo Agent Platform, GitLab Duo Chat, and AI workflows that represent the future of human/AI collaborative development. You'll develop novel testing methodologies (including for AI agent security), conduct hands-on penetration testing, and translate emerging threats into actionable security improvements. Your research will directly influence how we build and secure the next generation of AI-powered DevSecOps tools, ensuring GitLab remains the most secure software factory platform on the market.

This position offers the unique opportunity to shape security and AI security practices in one of the world's largest DevSecOps platforms, working with engineering teams who are pushing the boundaries of what's possible with AI-assisted software development. You'll have access to cutting-edge AI systems and the freedom to explore creative attack scenarios while contributing to the security of millions of developers worldwide.

This role reports to the Senior Manager of Application Security.

What you'll do

  • Conduct and lead security research projects across multiple functional areas.
  • Identify novel, systemic, and chained vulnerabilities in GitLab, where individual weaknesses combine for outsized impact.
  • Validate security vulnerabilities through hands-on testing, developing proof-of-concept exploits that demonstrate real-world attack scenarios.
  • Assess emerging industry vulnerability classes against the GitLab codebase, and drive remediation of the class rather than the instance.
  • Lead security research into GitLab's AI and agentic surfaces, and define the security requirements that engineering teams build against.
  • Build and direct the tooling and automation that scales security research, including agent-assisted vulnerability discovery across our codebase.
  • Research the security posture of open source tools and dependencies integrated with GitLab, report findings to their maintainers, and track mitigation following our responsible disclosure guidelines.
  • Solve technical problems of the highest scope, complexity, and ambiguity.
  • Help shape the team and sub-department roadmap.
  • Lead the integration of security research results into the engineering and business functions that need to act on them.
  • Teach, mentor, and advise other domain experts and individual contributors across several teams.
  • Share knowledge and novel vulnerability types with the security community.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of experience in security research, penetration testing, or offensive security roles
  • Strong ability in discovering and exploiting vulnerabilities in large codebase and complex systems
  • Proficiency in two or more of Ruby, Go, Python, TypeScript, or Rust.
  • Ability to read and analyze code across multiple languages and codebases
  • Strong knowledge of AI frameworks
  • Strong understanding of AI attack vectors including prompt injection, agent manipulation, and workflow exploitation
  • At ease in establishing and driving complex remediation initiatives involving cross-functional teams
  • Excellent written communication skills with an ability to articulate complex topics in a clear and concise manner.
  • Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear risk assessments and remediation recommendations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with creative thinking about attack scenarios
  • Nice to Have: Published security research or conference presentations; background in software engineering with distributed systems expertise; experience with GitLab or similar DevSecOps platforms

About the team

Security Researchers are a part of ourApplication Security team, who address complex security challenges facing GitLab and its customers to enable GitLab to be the most secure software factory platform on the market. We focus on systemic product security risks and work cross-functionally to mitigate them while maintaining Engineering's development velocity.

jobs.excerpt: About bunny. netSome people accept the internet as it is.
jobs.description:
About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

Lead Product Engineer (Developer Platform)

What if you could design the way developers ship their workloads to the edge, starting from a blank page?

As a Lead Product Engineer at bunny.net, you'll own the Developer Platform and lead a small team of engineers. We already give developers the pieces to run compute close to their users: Magic Containers, Edge Scripting, and Database. What's missing is the glue: the part that turns a set of products into one obvious way to say "deploy my workload to bunny." That glue is yours: projects, environments like dev, staging, and production, secrets shared at the right level, logs you can actually read, and a container that talks to a database without a detour through the docs.

Product Engineering sits inside Engineering. There's no Product Manager handing over requirements: you carry the product responsibilities yourself, and you shape solutions with your engineers in the codebase, not just in the conversation. How much you build yourself depends on you and on what the team needs, but shipping code is part of the role, not a bonus.

It’s a role for someone who loves both the why and the how, combining strong product judgment with technical depth, and knowing when to get hands-on and when to help others find the way forward.

You’ll have the context to see the bigger picture, the freedom to challenge assumptions, and teams that challenge your thinking right back.

If you love being close to developers, turning a blank page into something people ship on every day, and helping a team get the details right, you'll feel right at home here.

What will you do?

  • Design the primitives developers use, such as projects, environments, secrets, and logs, and how they behave across Magic Containers, Edge Scripting, and Database, so deploying, configuring, connecting, and debugging a workload on bunny.net feels like one product

  • Shape Developer Platform product direction from discovery through delivery and iteration, turning developer insights into clear priorities

  • Spot and resolve platform or product decisions that break the unified developer experience before they ship

  • Bring clarity to hard problems and give teams the context to make great decisions on their own, raising the bar for product thinking, technical judgment, and ownership beyond your own team

  • Lead a small engineering team: set direction, develop people, give clear feedback, and hold a high bar for what you ship and run

  • Build alongside your engineers across prototypes, APIs, dashboard, instrumentation, docs, and production code

  • Define and measure success, from first deploy to adoption and expansion, and use what you learn to decide what comes next

  • Work across Compute, Frontend, Design, and Product Marketing to create a cohesive experience across the dashboard, API, CLI, and docs

What will you bring?

  • Ideally, you’ve owned the full discovery → delivery → iteration loop at meaningful scale, or you’re ready to take on that level of end-to-end ownership

  • Strong product judgment and a knack for turning messy, ambiguous problems into meaningful outcomes

  • Comfort with data: knowing what to measure, what funnels and retention curves are telling you, and when to run an experiment

  • Business and market literacy: ICP, pricing, competition, revenue drivers, and how your product supports bunny.net's wider strategy

  • Strong technical depth to challenge solutions, make trade-offs, and ship production changes yourself

  • A high bar for quality, reliability, performance, security, and customer trust

  • A track record of helping others make better decisions and take more ownership

  • Clear communication, high ownership, and low ego

  • AI fluency: using AI thoughtfully across research, analysis, prototyping, coding, testing, and communication, while staying accountable for quality

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience building developer platforms, deployment tools, or products where the developer experience is the product

  • You've deployed, configured, and debugged your own workloads on similar platforms

  • You’re as comfortable talking to customers as you are digging into the technology

  • You naturally think beyond individual features and see how products, systems, and teams fit together

  • Experience leading engineers: developing people, giving feedback, and creating the conditions for a team to make product decisions rather than execute tasks

Where should you be located?

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

  • Music on us: Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Technical Account Manager

About the job

Twilio is looking for an experienced Technical Account Manager who is going to be the designated technical support engineering contact for our strategic customers. As a designated TAM you will be supporting customers during Eastern hours (9am to 6pm ET) and working on the cases created by customers and resolving complex technical problems with potentially very costly and far-reaching consequences. You should have an interest in digging deep as well as be able to zoom out and look at the larger picture. The TAM delivers proactive guidance to the customer to provide added value through the use of Twilio technologies and deliver recommendations to make the customer’s environment less susceptible to business impacting downtime. About Bitdeer Technologies Group

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for AI and Bitcoin mining infrastructure.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers and building AI computational infrastructure to support the AI revolution. Bitdeer handles complex processes involved in computing such as equipment procurement, transport logistics, data center design and construction, equipment management, and daily operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia.

To learn more, visit

Job Description

You are the paved road for every AI product we ship — the CI/CD, IDP, and MLOps substrate that lets model teams deploy without opening a ticket.

Position Summary

Bitdeer is building an AI-operated GPU cloud, and the AI Cloud team ships the products on top of it. As Cloud Senior DevOps Engineer you build the paved road those products travel down: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, MLOps pipelines, and the Internal Developer Platform that lets model, data-science, and product teams deploy at speed without stepping around governance. You are the bridge between research and production, and the operator of the platform substrate the AIOps team plugs into.

Key Responsibilities

  • CI/CD & MLOps Pipeline Management: Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines for both software applications and machine learning models. Automate build, test, deployment, and rollback processes to ensure seamless transitions from innovation to production.
  • Cloud-Native & AI Infrastructure: Build, optimize, and scale cloud-native infrastructure using Kubernetes (K8s) and Docker. Manage and provision specialized computing resources (e.g., GPU clusters) to support high-performance AI workloads and model inferencing.
  • High Availability Architecture: Take ownership of high-availability design in production environments. Implement disaster recovery (DR) strategies, self-healing mechanisms, capacity planning, and performance tuning to meet stringent business SLAs.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Champion IaC practices utilizing tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Helm to achieve fully automated, reproducible, and auditable infrastructure provisioning across multiple cloud environments.
  • Observability & Monitoring: Architect and refine comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK stack) to provide deep visibility into system health, application performance, and AI model metrics. Feed the AIOps substrate with clean, well-labeled telemetry.
  • Internal Developer Platform (IDP): Build the paved road that lets product, model, and data-science teams deploy without opening a ticket. Make golden paths so obvious that shortcuts feel harder than doing it right.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with R&D, Data Science, Security, and Business teams to streamline workflows, eliminate bottlenecks, and continuously elevate engineering efficiency.
  • Governance, Security & Compliance: Establish and enforce system stability and security standards. Manage release workflows, implement Zero Trust access controls, oversee secrets management, and ensure compliance (e.g., SOC2, ISO27001).
  • Incident Management & Resolution: Act as the technical lead during complex system anomalies and major incidents. Spearhead rapid troubleshooting, thorough RCA, and preventative remediation — and turn each incident into an automation that stops the next one before it pages a human.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience & Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, with 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Infrastructure roles.
  • Networking & OS: Expert-level knowledge of Linux operating systems and core networking principles (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, Load Balancing, VPCs).
  • Containerization & Orchestration: Deep mastery of Docker and Kubernetes orchestration, including a thorough understanding of underlying principles, cluster management, and production-level best practices.
  • Cloud Platforms: Proven proficiency in designing and managing infrastructure on major Public or Hybrid Cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure, Alibaba Cloud), including multi-cloud and hybrid-cloud strategies.
  • Programming Skills: Strong coding and scripting capabilities in at least one major language (Go, Python, Shell, etc.) with a solid engineering-oriented mindset focused on automation and tooling development.
  • Domain Knowledge: Systematic and practical understanding of CI/CD methodologies, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), Observability paradigms, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional problem-solving abilities, sharp technical judgment, and excellent cross-team communication skills to effectively collaborate in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Preferred Qualifications (Plus)

  • AI/ML Infrastructure Experience: Familiarity with MLOps practices, model serving/inferencing frameworks (e.g., vLLM, TGI, Triton Inference Server), and experience managing GPU clusters for AI/ML workloads.
  • Large-Scale Systems: Proven track record working with large-scale distributed systems or high-concurrency environments (e.g., Fintech, Trading, Real-time processing, or AI platforms).
  • Platform Engineering: Hands-on experience in designing and building Internal Developer Platforms (IDP) to enhance developer autonomy and productivity.
  • Advanced Security: Deep familiarity with Zero Trust architecture, automated security testing (DevSecOps), and implementing strict compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC2, ISO27001).
  • Leadership: Prior experience acting as a Technical Lead, mentoring junior engineers, or managing DevOps teams.
  • AIOps Builder Mindset: You see incidents, tickets, and manual runbooks as source material for the next automation, not as steady-state work. You've either wired an LLM-driven code/config helper into a pipeline or have strong opinions on how to.
  • Paved-Road Philosophy: You think in golden paths and defaults, not policies; you'd rather make the right thing easy than write a doc scolding people for doing the wrong thing.

Bitdeer is committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with country, state, and local laws. Bitdeer does not discriminate against employees or applicants based on conditions such as race, color, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, marital and/or parental status, religion, political opinion, nationality, ethnic background or social origin, social status, disability, age, indigenous status, and union.

Salary: $180,000 – $260,000

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for an experienced Staff Frontend QA Automation Engineer to join our fast-growing tech team in HCMC, focusing on web applications and browser-based user journeys.
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Staff Frontend QA Automation Engineer to join our fast-growing tech team in HCMC, focusing on web applications and browser-based user journeys. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable frontend automation using Playwright to ensure our users have a seamless, high-performance web experience.

Overview:

Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

The role:

You’ll be joining our fast-growing tech team, focusing on our web applications, frontend user journeys, and browser-based experiences. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable automation using Playwright to ensure our users have a seamless, high-performance experience.

Your rigorous attention to detail and excellent communication skills will be essential. If you are passionate about quality and have a proven competence in automating test cases for frontend and web applications, we’d like to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain frontend end-to-end test suites in Playwright and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines for our core web applications.

  • Ensure consistent functionality and UI/UX integrity across modern browsers, responsive layouts, and screen resolutions.

  • Conduct a mix of manual exploration and automated regression to find and report frontend-specific bugs, from flaky UI states and accessibility issues to broken journeys.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineers and Product Managers to develop effective strategies and test plans for our web applications.

  • Help troubleshoot issues in production and staging environments.

  • Conduct post-release/post-implementation testing including regression, accessibility, and integration testing for frontend systems.

Essential Skills:

  • Frontend Automation: Experience building robust web automation frameworks using Playwright, with a focus on reliable end-to-end and cross-browser functional testing.

  • Frontend CI/CD Integration: Experience integrating Playwright test suites into build pipelines, including parallel execution, test reporting, trace/video capture, and flaky test management.

  • JavaScript/TypeScript Proficiency: Strong JavaScript or TypeScript programming skills, with confidence building maintainable test frameworks and utilities.

  • DevOps Ecosystem: Experience with build and configuration tools such as GitHub Actions and CircleCI.

  • Browser & UI Savvy: A keen eye for frontend-specific nuances, including responsive behaviour, accessibility, browser compatibility, loading states, and visual consistency.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication in spoken and written English, paired with a product mindset and rigorous attention to detail.

Extra credit if you:

  • Have worked with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Angular.

  • Experience working with backend services.

  • Experience with BDD and implementing Cucumber for automation.

  • Have experience with accessibility testing, visual regression testing, or performance testing for web applications.

  • Are able to understand the business context of what you’re doing – understand the value your work creates.

  • Experience with Agentic AI workflows for testing.

The role is based in our Ho Chi Minh office (at ///become.outlooks.rising). While you can work from the office five days a week if preferred, our Engineering team can choose to work up to two days a week from home. We also offer a six-week remote-work allowance; for up to six weeks a year, you can work from anywhere in the world (as long as you’ve got great WiFi and are happy to work on the HQ timezone).

Diversity & Inclusion

Our mission is to help everyone talk about everywhere, and we believe diverse perspectives make for a better company and better products too. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups and are committed to equality and inclusivity in our hiring processes and company culture.

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate Senior DevOps Engineer with strong experience in Storage to join our Platform Engineering team. As a core member of the team, you will actively contribute to the full platform ecosystem: infrastructure automation, continuous delivery pipelines, self-service provisioning capabilities, production operations runbooks, and L2 support.

You will bring a broader DevOps culture and mindset, with a solid command of AWS infrastructure, tooling, and modern platform practices including AIOps and advanced Kubernetes.

In addition to your full platform engineering contributions, you will serve as a team's storage domain expert, particularly around NetApp on AWS. This specialization will be especially prominent in the early stages of your onboarding, but it does not define the boundaries of your role. You will investigate and resolve storage-related incidents at L2 level, while also continuing to contribute across all dimensions of the platform.

This is a hands-on, automation-first role where you are expected to codify everything, document what you build, and make it available as a self-service to the engineering teams around you.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Platform Engineering (Full Scope)

  • Contribute to infrastructure automation across the AWS platform using Terraform Enterprise, Ansible, Harness, Kubernetes (including operators, CRDs, and cluster lifecycle management), and GitOps practices

  • Support and evolve continuous delivery pipelines, ensuring reliable and repeatable deployments across environments (PRE, SBX, PRD)

  • Design and implement storage architectures on AWS with high availability and fault tolerance

  • Provide L2 support on storage incidents, leading investigations on performance degradation, availability issues, and data integrity events

  • Integrate storage with Kubernetes workloads (persistent volumes, storage classes, CSI drivers) and backup solutions (AWS Backup, Netapp B&R)

  • Ensure compliance with RPO/RTO objectives and contribute to DR testing and validation

  • Administer and continuously improve the Active Directory and DNS environment, with a focus on performance optimization, security compliance, and alignment with business objectives

Tools Used Daily

AWS, NetApp, Terraform Enterprise, Harness, Ansible, GitHub Copilot, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Kargo, Kubernetes, Rancher, Datadog, Splunk, Vault, Jira, Confluence

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • 5+ years of hands-on DevOps experience building and operating a SaaS platform on AWS

  • 3+ years of experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) in an AWS environment

  • 2+ years of experience as a platform engineer, contributing to automation and self-service ecosystems

  • Solid Kubernetes knowledge.

  • Solid knowledge of NetApp ONTAP (administration, provisioning, troubleshooting)

  • Experience with AWS storage services (S3, EBS, EFS, FSx)

  • Experience integrating storage with Kubernetes workloads (PV, PVC, StorageClass, CSI drivers)

  • Experience providing L2 support on automation systems and/or storage infrastructure

  • Exposure to AIOps practices: intelligent alerting, anomaly detection, AI-assisted automation (Datadog AI, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent)

  • Familiarity with CI/CD practices and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Kargo, GitHub Actions)

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Splunk, or equivalent)

  • Strong scripting or development skills in Python, Bash, or Go

  • Passion for automation, documentation, and a platform engineering mindset

Preferred

  • Experience building Kubernetes operators or controllers (controller-runtime, kubebuilder)

  • Familiarity with Cilium or equivalent eBPF-based CNI for Kubernetes networking and security

  • Experience with claim-based or self-service provisioning patterns for infrastructure resources

  • Experience with backup and data protection solutions (AWS backup or Cohesity)

  • Knowledge of disaster recovery design and testing on AWS

  • FinOps awareness and cloud cost optimization experience

  • Familiarity with secret management tools (Vault)

  • NetApp certifications (NCDA, NCIE) are a plus

What We Offer

  • MacBook Pro or equivalent equipment

  • Access to AI productivity tools (ChatGPT, Copilot)

  • International collaboration across DevOps, SRE, and Engineering teams

  • Medical, sports, and life insurance

  • Equity Incentive Plan participation

Our Values Guide Everything We Do

  • Put our Customers’ Outcomes First: We are passionate about delivering the highest value for our customers and supporting them with end-to-end care throughout their journey with us.

  • Act with Integrity: Integrity is at the heart of everything we do. We take personal responsibility for our actions, own our decisions, and honour each other’s contributions. We empower each other through honesty, respect, trust and transparency.

Circuit Design Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Circuit Design Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving electronic hardware, circuit simulation, programmatic EDA workflows, verification, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks related to analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits. A representative task may require interpreting circuit requirements, producing or modifying a netlist or hardware description, running simulations or verification tools from the command line, analyzing the resulting outputs, and determining whether the design satisfies its electrical and functional constraints.

This role requires experience with real circuit designs that were fabricated, shipped, integrated, or taped out. Simulation-only academic experience is not sufficient. Candidates must also have experience with tools that support programmatic or command-line workflows.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Design, analyze, and validate analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits.
  2. Translate electrical requirements into schematics, netlists, models, HDL, constraints, or simulation inputs.
  3. Run circuit simulation, synthesis, verification, or related workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  4. Use Python to generate inputs, automate simulations, run parameter sweeps, control instruments, and analyze results.
  5. Evaluate voltage, current, power, gain, bandwidth, impedance, noise, timing, stability, thermal behavior, and other relevant outputs.
  6. Perform corner, tolerance, worst-case, transient, frequency-domain, or Monte Carlo analyses where appropriate.
  7. Compare simulated behavior with analytical calculations and physical measurements.
  8. Diagnose problems involving component selection, parasitics, layout, power integrity, signal integrity, thermal behavior, interfaces, or manufacturing.
  9. Review AI-generated circuit solutions and identify incorrect assumptions, invalid configurations, or unsupported conclusions.
  10. Develop reproducible reference solutions and automated verification checks.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline; or
  2. A BS in Electrical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of relevant professional circuit-design experience.
  3. Meaningful experience designing analog, digital, power, mixed-signal, or RF circuits.
  4. Experience with designs that were fabricated, integrated, shipped, or taped out—not only simulated.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one EDA, circuit-simulation, PCB, HDL, synthesis, or verification tool that supports CLI, scripting, text-based inputs, or a programmatic API.
  7. Strong understanding of circuit behavior, component selection, tolerances, failure modes, and design trade-offs.
  8. Experience with hardware bring-up, laboratory validation, design verification, or post-fabrication debugging.
  9. Ability to explain circuit behavior and technical decisions clearly.

Relevant tools may include ngspice, Xyce, Yosys, Verilator, KiCad scripting, SPICE-compatible simulators, HDL simulators, synthesis tools, or equivalent programmatic EDA software. Experience with a comparable CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include PySpice, NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, cocotb, instrument-control libraries, EDA APIs, or internally developed automation tools. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete a technical assessment, if required.
  4. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

jobs.description:
About the role

Gcore operates a global edge platform: a content delivery network, authoritative and recursive DNS, and the traffic management layer that decides where requests land. It carries production traffic for media, gaming and enterprise customers, and the difference between a good and a bad engineering decision is visible in latency and availability within minutes.

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the teams that build and run the CDN control plane, the edge request path, the analytics and logging pipeline, and our traffic management services.

This is a leadership role with real technical weight. You will not be writing production code day to day, but you will be expected to hold your own in an architecture discussion, question a proposed fix when the evidence is thin, and own the consequences when something breaks at 3am.

What You Will Do

  • Lead four engineering teams covering the control plane, the core edge and proxy layer, the analytics and logging platform, and DNS and traffic management.
  • Own delivery on a two-week cadence: planning, commitments, and honest reporting on what shipped and what did not.
  • Set and defend technical priorities with Product, Support and Maintenance. A large part of the job is deciding what the teams will not do this quarter.
  • Own the incident and post-incident process for your area: severity calls, root-cause analysis, and making sure prevention work actually gets built rather than filed and forgotten.
  • Run the on-call rotation for your teams and keep the escalation path clear.
  • Develop your engineers and tech leads through regular one-to-ones, feedback and growth planning, and hire well when you have headcount.
  • Improve how the department works: planning, prioritisation, quality standards, documentation, and service ownership.
  • Ensure AI tools and approaches are being adopted.

The kind of problems you will be closer to

A sense of the work rather than an exhaustive list:

  • Cache and shielding behaviour: how a large origin is protected, and how configuration changes propagate to the edge safely.
  • Config delivery at scale: pushing configuration to a global fleet quickly, and knowing where its limits are.
  • Analytics cost and performance: keeping a high-volume ClickHouse estate fast and affordable.
  • Traffic steering and failover.
  • Observability that catches customer impact before the customer does.

What We are Looking For

  • Four or more years leading software engineering teams, including experience managing tech leads.
  • Production experience with internet infrastructure: CDN, DNS, reverse proxies, or large-scale distributed systems.
  • Enough depth to reason independently about HTTP caching, nginx behaviour, TLS and SNI, and anycast routing.
  • A track record of owning incident response and post-incident follow-through, not just attending the calls.
  • Comfort running several teams at once, and the confidence to say no to a stakeholder with a clear reason.
  • Experience with distributed teams spanning European and Asian working hours.

Nice to Have

  • C, Rust, Go, Python, at a level where you can review a change.
  • Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse and distributed tracing.
  • Kubernetes alongside bare-metal fleet operations.
  • Experience at a CDN, DNS or cloud provider, or at a network operator.
  • Experience acting as product owner for platform work.

What We can be Straight with You About

This is a mature platform with real customers and real legacy. Some services are owned by a single engineer, and reducing that dependency is part of the job. Product ownership for platform work is currently shared between engineering and product management, which means backlog quality depends partly on you. We would rather you knew that before joining than discovered it in month two.

In return you get a genuinely interesting technical domain, a small enough organisation that your decisions are visible, and direct access to the people setting product direction.

Benefits

At Gcore, we want you to do your best work and enjoy the journey. Our benefits are designed to support your growth, well-being, and life beyond work:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid or remote options, depending on your role
  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 45 days per year
  • Private medical insurance for you and your family*
  • Extra paid vacation and sick leave days*
  • Support for life’s important moments and celebrations
  • Language courses to help you connect and grow
  • Modern, welcoming offices with snacks, drinks, and entertainment*
  • Team sports and social activities*

*Benefits may vary depending on your location.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We provide equal opportunity to all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The world’s digital experiences run on something invisible: the infrastructure and software that keep them fast, reliable, and secure. At Gcore, you’ll help design and deliver that foundation for an AI-driven world.

We’re a global provider of infrastructure and software solutions for AI, cloud, network, and security, powering everything from real-time communication and streaming to enterprise AI and secure web applications. With 210+ edge locations, 50+ cloud regions, and thousands of GPUs, your work here can reach users and businesses across the globe.

You’ll collaborate with leading technology partners such as Intel, NVIDIA, Dell, and Equinix, and work on platforms that power digital products used around the world. Our vision is simple: to connect the world to AI, anywhere, anytime.

Want to work on technology that goes beyond a single product or industry? Join a global team of 550+ professionals building infrastructure and software that supports the entire digital ecosystem.
